// Visual remnants are separate from living NPCs: no AI, collisions, or rewards.
const deaths = new Map();
export const deathSettings = { duration: 0.38, fadeStart: 0.12, distance: 48 };

/** Freeze the defeated pose and launch it away from the source of the hit. */
export function beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source) {
  const dx = source ? enemy.x - source.x : enemy.contactReaction?.nx ?? 1;
  const dy = source ? enemy.y - source.y : enemy.contactReaction?.ny ?? 0;
  const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const death = { elapsed: 0, originX: enemy.x, originY: enemy.y,
    nx: length ? dx / length : 1, ny: length ? dy / length : 0, opacity: 1 };
  deaths.set(enemy.id, { ...enemy, death, transition: null, moving: false });
}

/** Advance every remnant, including offscreen ones, and remove after the fade. */
export function updateEnemyDeaths(delta) {
  for (const [id, enemy] of deaths) {
    const death = enemy.death;
    death.elapsed += delta;
    const progress = Math.min(1, death.elapsed / deathSettings.duration);
    const distance = deathSettings.distance * (1 - (1 - progress) ** 3);
    enemy.x = death.originX + death.nx * distance;
    enemy.y = death.originY + death.ny * distance;
    const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
      (death.elapsed - deathSettings.fadeStart) / (deathSettings.duration - deathSettings.fadeStart)));
    death.opacity = 1 - fade * fade;
    if (progress === 1) deaths.delete(id);
  }
}

/** Return visual-only remnants for the same camera culling as normal enemies. */

import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';

// EDIT attack balance and timing here. Interval is measured start to start.
export const umbrellaSettings = { interval: 1, duration: 0.4, reach: 112, damage: 20 };
const crop = { x: 100, y: 228, width: 68, height: 304 };

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / umbrellaSettings.duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  return aim - Math.PI / 2 + eased * Math.PI;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle) {
  const dx = enemy.x - player.x, dy = enemy.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || 112) * 0.18;
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach + radius) return false;
  if (distance <= radius) return true;
  const center = (fromAngle + toAngle) / 2;
  const difference = Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dy, dx) - center), Math.cos(Math.atan2(dy, dx) - center));
  return Math.abs(difference) <= (toAngle - fromAngle) / 2 + Math.asin(Math.min(1, radius / distance));
}

/** Load the umbrella and own its repeating attack, hit tracking, and motion trail. */
export function createUmbrellaAttack() {
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = '../sprites/plana umbrella.png';
  const ready = image.decode();
  let owner;
  let cycle = 0;
  let swing;

  /** Cancel attacks on avatar/loadout changes and start one sweep every second. */
  function update(delta, player, aim) {
    const equipped = player.attackSlots?.some(item => item?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
    if (!equipped) { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; return; }
    if (owner !== player) { owner = player; swing = null; cycle = 0; }
    if (!swing && cycle <= 0) swing = { aim, elapsed: 0, previous: aim - Math.PI / 2, hits: new Set() };
    cycle += delta;
    if (swing) {
      swing.elapsed = Math.min(umbrellaSettings.duration, swing.elapsed + delta);
      const angle = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, swing.elapsed);
      for (const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
        if (!swing.hits.has(enemy.id) && umbrellaHits(player, enemy, swing.previous, angle)) {
          swing.hits.add(enemy.id);
          damageEnemy(enemy.id, umbrellaSettings.damage, player);
        }
      }
      swing.previous = angle;
      if (swing.elapsed >= umbrellaSettings.duration) swing = null;
    }
    if (cycle >= umbrellaSettings.interval) cycle %= umbrellaSettings.interval;
  }

  /** Draw one handle-anchored closed umbrella pose, pointing along the swing. */
  function drawBlade(context, angle, alpha) {
    context.save();
    context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
    context.globalAlpha = alpha;
    const length = umbrellaSettings.reach;
    const width = length * crop.width / crop.height;
    context.drawImage(image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
      -width / 2, -length, width, length);
    context.restore();
  }

  /** Use a tapered arc and fading prior poses to convey speed without flashing. */
  function draw(context, camera) {
    if (!swing || !image.naturalWidth) return;
    context.save();
    context.translate(owner.x - camera.x, owner.y - camera.y);
    const angle = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, swing.elapsed);
    const fade = Math.min(1, (umbrellaSettings.duration - swing.elapsed) / 0.08);
    for (let i = 5; i >= 1; i--) {
      const earlier = Math.max(0, swing.elapsed - i * 0.014);
      const previous = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, earlier);
      context.beginPath();
      context.arc(0, 0, umbrellaSettings.reach * (0.76 + i * 0.035), previous, angle);
      context.strokeStyle = `rgba(231, 148, 240, ${0.045 * fade})`;
      context.lineWidth = 2 + (6 - i) * 1.2;
      context.stroke();
      drawBlade(context, previous, 0.025 * (6 - i) * fade);
    }
    drawBlade(context, angle, fade);
    context.restore();
  }

  /** Clear a pending swing when the scene is reset. */
  function reset() { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; }
  return { ready, update, draw, reset };

import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';

// EDIT attack balance and timing here. Interval is measured start to start.
export const umbrellaSettings = {
  interval: 1, duration: 0.3, damage: 20,
  baseRadius: 64, // EDIT where the handle's orbit begins, outside Plana's sprite.
  reach: 176, // Outer tip radius; blade length is reach minus baseRadius.
  trailDuration: 0.09, trailAngleStep: 0.012, maxAfterimages: 192
};
const crop = { x: 100, y: 228, width: 68, height: 304 };

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180Â° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / umbrellaSettings.duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  return aim - Math.PI / 2 + eased * Math.PI;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle) {
  const dx = enemy.x - player.x, dy = enemy.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || 112) * 0.18;
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach + radius) return false;
  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.baseRadius) return false;
  if (distance <= radius) return true;
  const center = (fromAngle + toAngle) / 2;
  const difference = Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dy, dx) - center), Math.cos(Math.atan2(dy, dx) - center));
  return Math.abs(difference) <= (toAngle - fromAngle) / 2 + Math.asin(Math.min(1, radius / distance));
}

/** Load the umbrella and own its repeating attack, hit tracking, and motion trail. */
export function createUmbrellaAttack() {
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = '../sprites/plana umbrella.png';
  const ready = image.decode();
  let owner;
  let cycle = 0;
  let swing;

  /** Cancel attacks on avatar/loadout changes and start one sweep every second. */
  function update(delta, player, aim) {
    const equipped = player.attackSlots?.some(item => item?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
    if (!equipped) { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; return; }
    if (owner !== player) { owner = player; swing = null; cycle = 0; }
    cycle = Math.max(0, cycle - delta);
    if (!swing && cycle <= 0) {
      swing = { aim, elapsed: 0, previous: aim - Math.PI / 2, hits: new Set() };
      cycle = umbrellaSettings.interval;
    }
    if (swing) {
      swing.elapsed = Math.min(umbrellaSettings.duration, swing.elapsed + delta);
      const angle = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, swing.elapsed);
      for (const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
        if (!swing.hits.has(enemy.id) && umbrellaHits(player, enemy, swing.previous, angle)) {
          swing.hits.add(enemy.id);
          damageEnemy(enemy.id, umbrellaSettings.damage, player);
        }
      }
      swing.previous = angle;
      if (swing.elapsed >= umbrellaSettings.duration) swing = null;
    }
  }

  /** Draw one handle-anchored closed umbrella pose, pointing along the swing. */
  function drawBlade(context, angle, alpha) {
    context.save();
    context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
    context.globalAlpha = alpha;
    const length = umbrellaSettings.reach - umbrellaSettings.baseRadius;
    const width = length * crop.width / crop.height;
    context.drawImage(image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
      -width / 2, -umbrellaSettings.reach, width, length);
    context.restore();
  }

  /** Use a tapered arc and fading prior poses to convey speed without flashing. */
  function draw(context, camera) {
    if (!swing || !image.naturalWidth) return;
    context.save();
    context.translate(owner.x - camera.x, owner.y - camera.y);
    const angle = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, swing.elapsed);
    const fade = Math.min(1, (umbrellaSettings.duration - swing.elapsed) / 0.08);
    context.lineCap = 'round';
    for (let i = 5; i >= 1; i--) {
      const earlier = Math.max(0, swing.elapsed - i * 0.02);
      const previous = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, earlier);
      context.beginPath();
      const trailRadius = umbrellaSettings.baseRadius +
        (umbrellaSettings.reach - umbrellaSettings.baseRadius) * (0.76 + i * 0.035);
      context.arc(0, 0, trailRadius, previous, angle);
      context.strokeStyle = `rgba(244, 169, 255, ${0.12 * fade})`;
      context.lineWidth = 4 + (6 - i) * 2;
      context.stroke();
    }
    // Sample by ANGLE, not time: fast parts of the swing need more overlapping
    // poses, otherwise evenly timed ghosts separate into individual umbrellas.
    const trailStart = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim,
      Math.max(0, swing.elapsed - umbrellaSettings.trailDuration));
    const span = angle - trailStart;
    const samples = Math.min(umbrellaSettings.maxAfterimages,
      Math.ceil(span / umbrellaSettings.trailAngleStep));
    for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
      const weight = i / samples;
      drawBlade(context, trailStart + span * weight,
        (0.018 + 0.032 * weight * weight) * fade);
    }
    drawBlade(context, angle, fade);
    context.restore();
  }

  /** Clear a pending swing when the scene is reset. */
  function reset() { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; }
  return { ready, update, draw, reset };
}

import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';

// EDIT attack balance and timing here. Interval is measured start to start.
export const umbrellaSettings = {
  interval: 1, duration: 0.2, damage: 20,
  baseRadius: 64, // EDIT where the handle's orbit begins, outside Plana's sprite.
  reach: 176, // Outer tip radius; blade length is reach minus baseRadius.
  trailDuration: 0.13, trailAngleStep: 0.012, maxAfterimages: 192,
  trailBlur: 3, trailLinger: 0.18 // Blur in pixels; fade time after the attack ends.
};
const crop = { x: 100, y: 228, width: 68, height: 304 };

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180Â° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / umbrellaSettings.duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  return aim - Math.PI / 2 + eased * Math.PI;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle) {
  const dx = enemy.x - player.x, dy = enemy.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || 112) * 0.18;
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach + radius) return false;
  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.baseRadius) return false;
  if (distance <= radius) return true;
  const center = (fromAngle + toAngle) / 2;
  const difference = Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dy, dx) - center), Math.cos(Math.atan2(dy, dx) - center));
  return Math.abs(difference) <= (toAngle - fromAngle) / 2 + Math.asin(Math.min(1, radius / distance));
}

/** Load the umbrella and own its repeating attack, hit tracking, and motion trail. */
export function createUmbrellaAttack() {
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = '../sprites/plana umbrella.png';
  const ready = image.decode();
  // Composite the dense trail first, then blur once instead of per afterimage.
  const trailCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const trailCenter = Math.ceil(umbrellaSettings.reach + umbrellaSettings.trailBlur * 4 + 8);
  trailCanvas.width = trailCanvas.height = trailCenter * 2;
  const trailContext = trailCanvas.getContext('2d');
  let owner;
  let cycle = 0;
  let swing;

  /** Cancel attacks on avatar/loadout changes and start one sweep every second. */
  function update(delta, player, aim) {
    const equipped = player.attackSlots?.some(item => item?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
    if (!equipped) { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; return; }
    if (owner !== player) { owner = player; swing = null; cycle = 0; }
    cycle = Math.max(0, cycle - delta);
    if (!swing && cycle <= 0) {
      swing = { aim, elapsed: 0, previous: aim - Math.PI / 2, hits: new Set() };
      cycle = umbrellaSettings.interval;
    }
    if (swing) {
      const wasAttacking = swing.elapsed < umbrellaSettings.duration;
      swing.elapsed += delta;
      const angle = umbrellaSwingAngle(swing.aim, swing.elapsed);
      for (const enemy of wasAttacking ? getAllEnemies() : []) {
        if (!swing.hits.has(enemy.id) && umbrellaHits(player, enemy, swing.previous, angle)) {
          swing.hits.add(enemy.id);
          damageEnemy(enemy.id, umbrellaSettings.damage, player);
        }
      }
      swing.previous = angle;
      if (swing.elapsed >= umbrellaSettings.duration + umbrellaSettings.trailLinger) swing = null;
    }
  }

  /** Draw one handle-anchored closed umbrella pose, pointing along the swing. */
  function drawBlade(context, angle, alpha) {
    context.save();
    context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
    context.globalAlpha = alpha;
    const length = umbrellaSettings.reach - umbrellaSettings.baseRadius;
    const width = length * crop.width / crop.height;
    context.drawImage(image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
      -width / 2, -umbrellaSettings.reach, width, length);
    context.restore();
  }

  /** Use a tapered arc and fading prior poses to convey speed without flashing. */
  function draw(outputContext, camera) {
    if (!swing || !image.naturalWidth) return;
    const context = trailContext;
    context.clearRect(0, 0, trailCanvas.width, trailCanvas.height);

/** Apply damage and trigger a brief sprite pulse; remove defeated test enemies. */
export function damageEnemy(id, amount, source) {
  const enemy = enemies.get(id);
  if (!enemy || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - amount);
  enemy.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
  if (enemy.hp === 0) {
    dropEnemyExp(enemy);
    dropEnemyLoot(enemy);
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source);
    enemies.delete(id);
  }
  return enemy;
}

/** Return enemies near the viewport for future rendering; retain all other records. */
export function getVisibleEnemies(cameraX, viewportWidth, margin = 160) {
  return [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy =>
    enemy.x >= cameraX - margin &&
    enemy.x <= cameraX + viewportWidth + margin
  );
}

import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

export const damageNumberSettings = { duration: 0.75, fadeStart: 0.32, riseSpeed: 150, gravity: 400, maxCount: 256 };
const numbers = [];
const textCache = new Map();
let font;

/** Load one shared bitmap font for all damage numbers. */
export function loadDamageNumberGraphics() {
  font = new Image();
  font.src = '../sprites/font.png';
  return font.decode();
}

/** Queue actual HP lost at the hit position; zero/invalid damage has no popup. */
export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false) {
  if (!(amount > 0) || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
  numbers.push({ text: String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100), player, elapsed: 0,
    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
    drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
}

/** Calculate the upward bounce, downward fall, and gradual end fade. */
export function damageNumberPose(number) {
  const t = number.elapsed;
  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,
    y: number.y - damageNumberSettings.riseSpeed * t + damageNumberSettings.gravity * t * t / 2,
    opacity: 1 - fade * fade };
}

/** Expire popups even when their targets die or leave the viewport. */
export function updateDamageNumbers(delta) {
  for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    numbers[i].elapsed += delta;
    if (numbers[i].elapsed >= damageNumberSettings.duration) numbers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/** Cache compact bitmap numbers; red tint preserves the font's dark outline. */
function numberGraphic(text, red) {
  const key = `${text}:${red}`;
  if (textCache.has(key)) return textCache.get(key);
  const glyphs = [...text].map(letter => fontMetrics[letter] || fontMetrics['?']);
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = glyphs.reduce((sum, glyph) => sum + glyph.width - 1, 1);
  canvas.height = 20;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let x = 0;
  for (const glyph of glyphs) {
    context.drawImage(font, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
      x, glyph.offsetY, glyph.width, glyph.height);
    x += glyph.width - 1;
  }
  if (red) {
    const mask = document.createElement('canvas');
    mask.width = canvas.width;
    mask.height = canvas.height;
    mask.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    context.fillStyle = '#ff5265';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
    context.drawImage(mask, 0, 0);
  }
  if (textCache.size >= 128) textCache.delete(textCache.keys().next().value);
  textCache.set(key, canvas);
  return canvas;
}

/** Draw world-anchored numbers above actors, leaving the HUD unaffected. */
export function drawDamageNumbers(context, camera, width, height) {
  if (!font?.naturalWidth) return;
  context.save();
  context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  for (const number of numbers) {
    const pose = damageNumberPose(number);
    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
    if (x < -100 || y < -50 || x > width + 100 || y > height + 50) continue;
    const graphic = numberGraphic(number.text, number.player);
    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
    context.drawImage(graphic, x - graphic.width * 0.625, y, graphic.width * 1.25, 25);
  }
  context.restore();
}

import { addPlayerExp } from './player-stats.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// World-space records survive camera scrolling and map switches for this session.
const drops = new Map();
let nextId = 0;
const iconWidth = 28; // EDIT ground report size in display pixels.
const pickupRadius = 26; // EDIT walk-over collection radius in world pixels.
export const pickupMagnet = { acceleration: 1200, maxSpeed: 650 }; // Pixels/secÂ² and pixels/sec.
export const creditDropChance = 1 / 90; // EDIT occasional credit chance (~1.11%).
export const secretNoteDropChance = 0.001; // 0.1% per defeated enemy.
const lootTotals = { credits: 0, secretTechNotes: 0 }; // Shared across avatar swaps.

/** Read session inventory; spending and attack upgrades will be implemented later. */
export function getLootTotals() {
  return { ...lootTotals };
}

/** Inspect all ground loot, including credits and Secret Tech Notes. */
export function getGroundLoot() {
  return [...drops.values()];
}

/** Spawn a specific ground pickup for repeatable admin testing. */
export function spawnTestDrop(kind, value, x, y) {
  if (!['exp', 'credits', 'secretTechNotes'].includes(kind)) return;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 1) return;
  const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind, value: Math.floor(value),
    tier: reportTier(value), x, y, rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Apply one pickup's reward without coupling inventory to the controlled avatar. */
function collectDrop(drop, player) {
  drops.delete(drop.id);
  if (drop.kind === 'exp') addPlayerExp(player, drop.value);
  else lootTotals[drop.kind] += drop.value;
}

/** Roll independent bonus drops, allowing both rewards on the same defeat. */
export function dropEnemyLoot(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const credits = random() < creditDropChance;
  const note = random() < secretNoteDropChance;
  for (const [kind, awarded] of [['credits', credits], ['secretTechNotes', note]]) {
    if (!awarded) continue;
    const drop = {
      id: ++nextId, kind, value: 1,
      x: enemy.x + (kind === 'credits' ? -18 : 18),
      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
    };
    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  }
}

/** Select artwork by EXP value; the highest supplied file is named Report 3. */
export function reportTier(value) {
  return value >= 50 ? 3 : value >= 20 ? 2 : value >= 11 ? 1 : 0;
}

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}

/** Place one report at the defeated enemy's feet, preserving its exact reward. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy) {
  const value = Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? 5);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  const drop = {
    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier: reportTier(value), x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
    rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Load report graphics once and provide collection/rendering for the preview. */
export function createExpPickups(getPlayer) {
  const lootStatus = document.querySelector('#player-loot-status');
  const tools = document.querySelector('#loot-tools');
  if (tools) {
    tools.querySelectorAll('[data-loot-action]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const player = getPlayer();
        const action = button.dataset.lootAction;
        if (action === 'clear') drops.clear();
        else if (action === 'collect') {
          for (const drop of drops.values()) collectDrop(drop, player);
        } else if (action === 'reset') {
          lootTotals.credits = 0;
          lootTotals.secretTechNotes = 0;
        } else {
          const amount = Number(tools.querySelector('[name="loot-value"]').value);
          spawnTestDrop(action, Math.min(1000000, amount), player.x + 80,
            player.y + (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding);
        }
      });
    });
  }
  const icons = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, tier) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.src = `../sprites/icons/Exp_Report_${tier}.png`;
    return image;
  });
  const ready = Promise.all(icons.map(image => image.decode()));
  const creditIcon = new Image();
  creditIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/credits.png';
  const creditReady = creditIcon.decode();
  const noteIcon = new Image();
  noteIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/Ultimate_Skill_Book.png';
  const noteReady = noteIcon.decode();

  /** Sweep direct pickups, then accelerate attracted loot toward the active avatar. */
  function update(player, previous, delta = 0) {
    const footOffset = (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
    const start = { x: previous.x, y: previous.y + footOffset };
    const end = { x: player.x, y: player.y + footOffset };
    const dx = end.x - start.x, dy = end.y - start.y;
    const lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      const fraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - start.x) * dx + (drop.y - start.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const sweptDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - start.x - dx * fraction, drop.y - start.y - dy * fraction);
      if (sweptDistance <= pickupRadius) {
        collectDrop(drop, player);
        continue;
      }
      const range = Math.max(0, player.pickupRange || 0);
      if (!range) {
        // Swapping to an avatar without attraction stops pending magnets immediately.
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        continue;
      }
      if (sweptDistance <= range) drop.attracted = true;
      if (drop.attracted) {
        const targetX = end.x - drop.x, targetY = end.y - drop.y;
        const distance = Math.hypot(targetX, targetY);
        const time = Math.max(0, delta);
        const speed = drop.pickupSpeed || 0;
        drop.pickupSpeed = Math.min(pickupMagnet.maxSpeed, speed + pickupMagnet.acceleration * time);
        const travel = Math.min(distance, (speed + drop.pickupSpeed) / 2 * time);
        if (distance > 0) {
          drop.x += targetX / distance * travel;
          drop.y += targetY / distance * travel;
        }
        if (distance - travel <= pickupRadius) collectDrop(drop, player);
      }
    }
    if (lootStatus) lootStatus.textContent = `Credits: ${lootTotals.credits} | Secret Tech Notes: ${lootTotals.secretTechNotes} | Ground drops: ${drops.size}`;
  }

  /** Draw only visible reports beneath actors, keeping their orientation fixed. */
  function draw(context, camera, width, height) {
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      const x = drop.x - camera.x, y = drop.y - camera.y;
      if (x < -iconWidth || y < -iconWidth || x > width + iconWidth || y > height + iconWidth) continue;
      const icon = drop.kind === 'exp' ? icons[drop.tier]
        : drop.kind === 'credits' ? creditIcon : noteIcon;
      const sourceWidth = icon.naturalWidth;
      const sourceHeight = icon.naturalHeight;
      if (!sourceWidth) continue;
      const iconHeight = iconWidth * sourceHeight / sourceWidth;
      context.save();
      context.translate(x, y);
      context.rotate(drop.rotation);
      context.drawImage(icon, -iconWidth / 2, -iconHeight / 2, iconWidth, iconHeight);
      context.restore();
    }
  }
  return { ready: Promise.all([ready, creditReady, noteReady]), update, draw };
}

import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';

// EDIT reaction distance/timing independently of normal chase speed.
export const contactSettings = {
  bounce: { distance: 52, travel: 0.18, recovery: 0.6 },
  push: { distance: 14, travel: 0.09, recovery: 0.18 },
  cooldown: 0.12,
  playerDamage: 10, // EDIT default HP lost per accepted contact hit.
  enemyDamage: 10,
  iFrameDuration: 0.5 // Seconds; shared protection against every overlapping enemy.
};

/** Detect player pass-through with a swept segment rather than endpoint overlap only. */
function contactGeometry(npc, player, motion) {
  const radius = ((npc.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) +
    (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)) * 0.18;
  const fromX = player.x - motion.x, fromY = player.y - motion.y;
  const lengthSquared = motion.x * motion.x + motion.y * motion.y;
  const t = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    ((npc.x - fromX) * motion.x + (npc.y - fromY) * motion.y) / lengthSquared)) : 1;
  const dx = npc.x - (fromX + motion.x * t);
  const dy = npc.y - (fromY + motion.y * t);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const pushing = lengthSquared > 0.0001 &&
    motion.x * (npc.x - fromX) + motion.y * (npc.y - fromY) > 0;
  // At exact overlap, push along player travel; otherwise away from the player.
  const fallbackLength = Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) || 1;
  return { touching: distance < radius, pushing, radius,
    nx: distance > 0.001 ? dx / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.x / fallbackLength : 1,
    ny: distance > 0.001 ? dy / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.y / fallbackLength : 0 };
}

/** React to contact, flash once, and pause chase until bounce/push recovery ends. */
export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move) {
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0)) {
    damagePlayer(player, contactSettings.playerDamage);
    player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;

  /** Sweep direct pickups, then accelerate attracted loot toward the active avatar. */
  function update(player, previous, delta = 0) {
    const footOffset = (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
    const start = { x: previous.x, y: previous.y + footOffset };
    const end = { x: player.x, y: player.y + footOffset };
    const dx = end.x - start.x, dy = end.y - start.y;
    const lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      // Let the toss finish so contact kills cannot instantly swallow the drops.
      if (updateDropScatter(drop, delta)) continue;
      const fraction = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
        ((drop.x - start.x) * dx + (drop.y - start.y) * dy) / lengthSquared)) : 0;
      const sweptDistance = Math.hypot(drop.x - start.x - dx * fraction, drop.y - start.y - dy * fraction);
      if (sweptDistance <= pickupRadius) {
        collectDrop(drop, player);
        continue;
      }
      const range = Math.max(0, player.pickupRange || 0);
      if (!range) {
        // Swapping to an avatar without attraction stops pending magnets immediately.
        drop.attracted = false;
        drop.pickupSpeed = 0;
        continue;
      }
      if (sweptDistance <= range) drop.attracted = true;
      if (drop.attracted) {
        const targetX = end.x - drop.x, targetY = end.y - drop.y;
        const distance = Math.hypot(targetX, targetY);
        const time = Math.max(0, delta);
        const speed = drop.pickupSpeed || 0;
        drop.pickupSpeed = Math.min(pickupMagnet.maxSpeed, speed + pickupMagnet.acceleration * time);
        const travel = Math.min(distance, (speed + drop.pickupSpeed) / 2 * time);
        if (distance > 0) {
          drop.x += targetX / distance * travel;
          drop.y += targetY / distance * travel;
        }
        if (distance - travel <= pickupRadius) collectDrop(drop, player);
      }
    }
    if (lootStatus) lootStatus.textContent = `Credits: ${lootTotals.credits} | Secret Tech Notes: ${lootTotals.secretTechNotes} | Ground drops: ${drops.size}`;
  }

  /** Draw only visible reports beneath actors, keeping their orientation fixed. */
  function draw(context, camera, width, height) {
    for (const drop of drops.values()) {
      const x = drop.x - camera.x, y = drop.y - camera.y - (drop.lift || 0);

import { showDamageNumber } from './damage-numbers.js';

// EDIT these values to tune the starting cost and flat increase per level.
export const startingLevelExp = 50;
export const expIncreasePerLevel = 15;

/** Return the next-level cost: 50 at level 1, then 15 more per level. */
export function experienceForLevel(level) {
  const current = Math.max(1, Math.floor(level));
  return startingLevelExp + expIncreasePerLevel * (current - 1);
}

/** Initialize session stats once; Development defaults to invincibility on. */
export function ensurePlayerStats(character) {
  character.level ??= 1;
  character.exp ??= 0;
  character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  character.maxHp ??= 100;
  character.hp ??= character.maxHp;
  character.invincible ??= true;
  return character;
}

/** Add experience, retaining overflow and supporting multiple level-ups per award. */
export function addPlayerExp(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  character.exp += Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(amount));
  while (character.exp >= character.maxExp) {
    character.exp -= character.maxExp;
    character.level++;
    character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  }
}

/** Death protection allows zero HP; use this check when handling player defeat. */
export function isPlayerDefeated(character) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  return character.hp <= 0 && !character.invincible;
}

/** Apply damage and its flash even while invincible, preserving HP bounds. */
}

  /** Refresh selection only when population changes, retaining the current ID. */
  function refresh() {
    list.replaceChildren();
    for (const npc of records()) {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = npc.id;
      option.textContent = `${npc.id} / ${npc.label}`;
      list.append(option);
    }
    if (!records().some(npc => npc.id === selectedId)) selectedId = records()[0]?.id || '';
    list.value = selectedId;
    feedback.textContent = `${records().length} NPCs / limit ${cap}. Shared across backgrounds; session-only state.`;
  }

  /** Clone an animation configuration into independent world-space NPC state. */
  function spawn(x, y) {
    if (getAllEnemies().length >= cap) {
      feedback.textContent = `Population limit (${cap}) reached. Delete NPCs before spawning more.`;
      return;
    }
    const type = field('npc-type').value;
    const template = characters[type];
    const size = template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
    if (!isPlacementClear(template, x, y)) return false;
    const npc = rememberEnemy(`npc-${++counter}`, {
      ...template, type,
      x: isVertical() ? Math.max(camera.x + size / 2, Math.min(camera.x + canvas.width - size / 2, x)) : x,
      y: isVertical() || isFreeScroll() ? y : Math.max(camera.y + size / 2, Math.min(camera.y + canvas.height - size / 2, y)),
      direction: template.defaultDirection || 'down', facing: template.defaultDirection || 'left',
      moving: false, elapsed: 0, attack: null, transition: null, lastPose: null,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: 2 / 3, // All test NPCs use 120 px/s; players remain at 240.
      ai: field('npc-ai').checked, behavior: field('npc-behavior').value,

      expReward: Math.max(0, Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(Number(field('npc-exp').value) || 0)))
    });

    return true;

  /** Spawn a bounded batch in the current visible world area. */
  function spawnBatch(position) {
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, Number(field('npc-count').value) || 1));
    let missed = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      let placed = false;
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < (position ? 1 : 30); attempt++) {
        placed = spawn(position ? position.x : camera.x + 140 + Math.random() * Math.max(0, canvas.width - 280),
          position ? position.y : camera.y + 140 + Math.random() * Math.max(0, canvas.height - 280));
        if (placed || getAllEnemies().length >= cap) break;
      }
      if (!placed) missed++;
    }
    refresh();
    if (missed) feedback.textContent += ` ${missed} spawn(s) blocked by obstacles or population limit.`;
  }

  panel.querySelector('#spawn-npc').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (field('npc-mode').value === 'random') spawnBatch();
    else feedback.textContent = 'Cursor spawn armed: left-click inside the game screen. Choose Inspect to stop spawning.';
  });
}

/** Select artwork by EXP value; the highest supplied file is named Report 3. */
export function reportTier(value) {
  return value >= 50 ? 3 : value >= 20 ? 2 : value >= 11 ? 1 : 0;
}

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}

/** Place one report at the defeated enemy's feet, preserving its exact reward. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy) {
  const value = Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? 5);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  const drop = {
    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier: reportTier(value), x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
    rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop);
  return drop;
}

VERBATIM FILE CHANGE | D:\code\AI Applications\TERM Project\Development\enemy-variants.js | content:
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

export const eliteChance = 0.03;

/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random) {
  const elite = type === 'mob' && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteChance));
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite ? 2 : 1),
    hp: elite ? 150 : 100,
    maxHp: elite ? 150 : 100,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1
  };
}

import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

export const eliteChance = 0.03;

/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random) {
  const elite = type === 'mob' && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteChance));
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite ? 2 : 1),
    hp: elite ? 150 : 100,
    maxHp: elite ? 150 : 100,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1
  };
}
}

/** Select artwork by EXP value; the highest supplied file is named Report 3. */
export function reportTier(value) {
  return value >= 50 ? 3 : value >= 21 ? 2 : value >= 11 ? 1 : 0;
}

/** Each defeat rolls 90% common 1-10 EXP, or 10% uncommon 11-20 EXP. */
export function rollEnemyExp(random = Math.random) {
  const uncommon = random() >= 0.9;
  return (uncommon ? 11 : 1) + Math.floor(random() * 10);
}

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}

/** Place one report at the defeated enemy's feet, preserving its exact reward. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const value = Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? rollEnemyExp(random));
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  const drop = {
    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier: reportTier(value), x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
    rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
  };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop, random);
  return drop;
}

  const lootStatus = document.querySelector('#player-loot-status');
  const tools = document.querySelector('#loot-tools');
  if (tools) {
    tools.querySelectorAll('[data-loot-action]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const player = getPlayer();

import { addPlayerExp } from './player-stats.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// World-space records survive camera scrolling and map switches for this session.
const drops = new Map();
let nextId = 0;
const iconWidth = 35; // EDIT drop size: 25% larger; roughly 30% of Plana's visible height.
const pickupRadius = 26; // EDIT walk-over collection radius in world pixels.
export const pickupMagnet = { acceleration: 1200, maxSpeed: 650 }; // Pixels/secÂ² and pixels/sec.
export const creditDropChance = 1 / 90; // EDIT occasional credit chance (~1.11%).
export const secretNoteDropChance = 0.001; // 0.1% per defeated enemy.
const lootTotals = { credits: 0, secretTechNotes: 0 }; // Shared across avatar swaps.
export const dropScatter = { duration: 0.28, minDistance: 40, maxDistance: 80, hopHeight: 18 };

/** Launch loot toward a random nearby landing spot with a small airborne hop. */

/** Roll independent bonus drops, allowing both rewards on the same defeat. */
export function dropEnemyLoot(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const credits = random() < creditDropChance;
  const note = random() < secretNoteDropChance;
  for (const [kind, awarded] of [['credits', credits], ['secretTechNotes', note]]) {
    if (!awarded) continue;
    const drop = {
      id: ++nextId, kind, value: 1,
      x: enemy.x,
      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
    };
    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
    launchDrop(drop, random);
  }
}

/** Select artwork by EXP value; the highest supplied file is named Report 3. */
export function reportTier(value) {
  return value >= 50 ? 3 : value >= 21 ? 2 : value >= 11 ? 1 : 0;
}

  /** Clone an animation configuration into independent world-space NPC state. */
  function spawn(x, y) {
    if (getAllEnemies().length >= cap) {
      feedback.textContent = `Population limit (${cap}) reached. Delete NPCs before spawning more.`;
      return;
    }
    const type = field('npc-type').value;
    const template = characters[type];
    const variant = enemyVariant(type, template, field('npc-variant').value);
    const size = variant.spriteSize;
    x = isVertical() ? Math.max(camera.x + size / 2, Math.min(camera.x + canvas.width - size / 2, x)) : x;
    y = isVertical() || isFreeScroll() ? y : Math.max(camera.y + size / 2, Math.min(camera.y + canvas.height - size / 2, y));
    if (!isPlacementClear({ ...template, ...variant }, x, y)) return false;
    const npc = rememberEnemy(`npc-${++counter}`, {
      ...template, type,
      x: isVertical() ? Math.max(camera.x + size / 2, Math.min(camera.x + canvas.width - size / 2, x)) : x,
      y: isVertical() || isFreeScroll() ? y : Math.max(camera.y + size / 2, Math.min(camera.y + canvas.height - size / 2, y)),
      direction: template.defaultDirection || 'down', facing: template.defaultDirection || 'left',
      moving: false, elapsed: 0, attack: null, transition: null, lastPose: null,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: 2 / 3, // All test NPCs use 120 px/s; players remain at 240.
      ai: field('npc-ai').checked, behavior: field('npc-behavior').value,
      wanderTimer: 0, wanderDirection: undefined, invincible: false,
      ...variant,
      // Default rewards roll on defeat; explicit admin overrides remain available.
      expReward: field('npc-exp-override').checked
        ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(Number(field('npc-exp').value) || 0))) : undefined
    });
    selectedId = npc.id;
    return true;
  }

  /** Spawn a bounded batch in the current visible world area. */
  function spawnBatch(position) {
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, Number(field('npc-count').value) || 1));
    let missed = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      let placed = false;
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < (position ? 1 : 30); attempt++) {
        placed = spawn(position ? position.x : camera.x + 140 + Math.random() * Math.max(0, canvas.width - 280),
          position ? position.y : camera.y + 140 + Math.random() * Math.max(0, canvas.height - 280));
        if (placed || getAllEnemies().length >= cap) break;
      }
      if (!placed) missed++;
    }
    refresh();
    if (missed) feedback.textContent += ` ${missed} spawn(s) blocked by obstacles or population limit.`;
  }

  panel.querySelector('#spawn-npc').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (field('npc-mode').value === 'random') spawnBatch();
    else feedback.textContent = 'Cursor spawn armed: left-click inside the game screen. Choose Inspect to stop spawning.';
  });
  list.addEventListener('change', () => { selectedId = list.value; });

  // Capture before aiming's click handler. NPC tool clicks never toggle aiming.
  canvas.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    const mode = field('npc-mode').value;
    if (mode === 'random') return;
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    const point = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY,
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), canvas.width, canvas.height);
    point.x += camera.x;
    point.y += camera.y;
    if (mode === 'cursor') spawnBatch(point);
    else {
      const closest = records().filter(npc =>
        Math.hypot(npc.x - point.x, npc.y - point.y) < (npc.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2
      ).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - point.x, a.y - point.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - point.x, b.y - point.y))[0];
      if (closest) {
        selectedId = closest.id;
        if (mode === 'delete') removeEnemy(selectedId);
        refresh();
      }
    }
  }, true);

  /** Dispatch selected-NPC and population actions from the admin panel. */
  panel.querySelectorAll('[data-npc-action]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const npc = getEnemy(selectedId);
      switch (button.dataset.npcAction) {
        case 'delete': if (npc) removeEnemy(npc.id); break;
        case 'clear': for (const entry of records()) removeEnemy(entry.id); break;
        case 'delete-visible':
          for (const entry of visible(0)) removeEnemy(entry.id);
          break;
        case 'apply-ai':
          if (npc) { npc.ai = field('npc-ai').checked; npc.behavior = field('npc-behavior').value; }
      </div>
      <p class="note">Animation tests: the boss pauses for one attack cycle, then resumes movement. No damage or

/** Roll a report's EXP value: elites get Report 1 (80%) or Report 2 (20%). */
export function rollEnemyExp(random = Math.random, elite = false) {
  if (elite) {
    return random() < 0.8 ? 11 + Math.floor(random() * 10) : 21 + Math.floor(random() * 29);
  }
  const uncommon = random() >= 0.9;
  return uncommon ? 11 + Math.floor(random() * 10) : 1 + Math.floor(random() * 9);
}

/** Expose ground records for inspection without deleting off-screen reports. */
export function getExpDrops() {
  return [...drops.values()].filter(drop => drop.kind === 'exp');
}

/** Drop three independently rolled reports for elites, otherwise one. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const reports = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < (enemy.elite ? 3 : 1); i++) {
    const drop = dropExpReport(enemy, random);
    if (drop) reports.push(drop);
  }
  return reports;
}

/** Create one scattered report; explicit admin EXP overrides remain supported. */
function dropExpReport(enemy, random) {
  const value = Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? rollEnemyExp(random, enemy.elite));
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  const drop = {
    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier: reportTier(value), x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
    rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
  };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop, random);
  return drop;
}

/** Load report graphics once and provide collection/rendering for the preview. */
export function createExpPickups(getPlayer) {
  const lootStatus = document.querySelector('#player-loot-status');
  const tools = document.querySelector('#loot-tools');
  if (tools) {
    tools.querySelectorAll('[data-loot-action]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const player = getPlayer();
        const action = button.dataset.lootAction;
        if (action === 'clear') drops.clear();
        else if (action === 'collect') {
          for (const drop of drops.values()) collectDrop(drop, player);
        } else if (action === 'reset') {
          lootTotals.credits = 0;
          lootTotals.secretTechNotes = 0;
        } else {
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

export const eliteChance = 0.03;

/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random) {
  const elite = type === 'mob' && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteChance));
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite ? 2 : 1),
    hp: elite ? 500 : 100,
    maxHp: elite ? 500 : 100,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1
  };
}

import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';

// EDIT reaction distance/timing independently of normal chase speed.
export const contactSettings = {
  bounce: { distance: 52, travel: 0.18, recovery: 0.6 },
  push: { distance: 14, travel: 0.09, recovery: 0.18 },
  cooldown: 0.12,
  playerDamage: 10, // EDIT default HP lost per accepted contact hit.
  mobDamage: 1, // Basic Mob contact damage; other NPCs keep the default above.
  iFrameDuration: 0.5 // Seconds; shared protection against every overlapping enemy.
};

/** Detect player pass-through with a swept segment rather than endpoint overlap only. */
function contactGeometry(npc, player, motion) {
  const radius = ((npc.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) +
    (player.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)) * 0.18;
  const fromX = player.x - motion.x, fromY = player.y - motion.y;
  const lengthSquared = motion.x * motion.x + motion.y * motion.y;
  const t = lengthSquared ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    ((npc.x - fromX) * motion.x + (npc.y - fromY) * motion.y) / lengthSquared)) : 1;
  const dx = npc.x - (fromX + motion.x * t);
  const dy = npc.y - (fromY + motion.y * t);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const pushing = lengthSquared > 0.0001 &&
    motion.x * (npc.x - fromX) + motion.y * (npc.y - fromY) > 0;
  // At exact overlap, push along player travel; otherwise away from the player.
  const fallbackLength = Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) || 1;
  return { touching: distance < radius, pushing, radius,
    nx: distance > 0.001 ? dx / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.x / fallbackLength : 1,
    ny: distance > 0.001 ? dy / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.y / fallbackLength : 0 };
}

/** React to contact, flash once, and pause chase until bounce/push recovery ends. */
export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move) {
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0)) {
    const baseDamage = npc.type === 'mob' ? contactSettings.mobDamage : contactSettings.playerDamage;
    damagePlayer(player, baseDamage * (npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1));
    player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;
  }
  const overrideBounce = npc.contactReaction?.kind === 'bounce' && hit.pushing;
  if (hit.touching && ((!npc.contactReaction && !npc.contactCooldown) || overrideBounce)) {
    const kind = hit.pushing ? 'push' : 'bounce';
    const settings = contactSettings[kind];
    const overlap = Math.max(0, hit.radius - Math.hypot(npc.x - player.x, npc.y - player.y));
    npc.contactReaction = {
      kind, elapsed: 0, nx: hit.nx, ny: hit.ny,
      distance: settings.distance + overlap, applied: 0
    };
    npc.attack = null;
  }
  const reaction = npc.contactReaction;
  if (!reaction) return false;
  const settings = contactSettings[reaction.kind];
  reaction.elapsed += delta;
  const t = Math.min(1, reaction.elapsed / settings.travel);
  const distance = reaction.distance * (1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t));
  const step = distance - reaction.applied;
  move(npc, reaction.nx * step, reaction.ny * step);
  reaction.applied = distance;
  const pauseChase = npc.contactRecoveryDelay !== false;
  if (pauseChase) npc.moving = false;
  const recovery = pauseChase ? settings.recovery : settings.travel;
  if (reaction.elapsed >= recovery) {
    npc.contactReaction = null;
    npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';

// EDIT attack balance and timing here. Interval is measured start to start:
// 1 second total = 0.2 seconds swinging + 0.8 seconds before the next swing.
export const umbrellaSettings = {
  interval: 1, duration: 0.2, damage: 23, arcDegrees: 190,
  baseRadius: 64, // EDIT where the handle's orbit begins, outside Plana's sprite.
  reach: 176, // Outer tip radius; blade length is reach minus baseRadius.
  trailDuration: 0.13, trailAngleStep: 0.012, maxAfterimages: 192,
  trailBlur: 3, trailLinger: 0.18 // Blur in pixels; fade time after the attack ends.
};
const crop = { x: 100, y: 228, width: 68, height: 304 };

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180Â° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / umbrellaSettings.duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  const arc = umbrellaSettings.arcDegrees * Math.PI / 180;
  return aim - arc / 2 + eased * arc;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle) {
  const dx = enemy.x - player.x, dy = enemy.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || 112) * 0.18;
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach + radius) return false;
  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.baseRadius) return false;
  if (distance <= radius) return true;
  const center = (fromAngle + toAngle) / 2;
  const difference = Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dy, dx) - center), Math.cos(Math.atan2(dy, dx) - center));
  return Math.abs(difference) <= (toAngle - fromAngle) / 2 + Math.asin(Math.min(1, radius / distance));
}

export function createUmbrellaAttack() {
  const image = new Image();
  image.src = '../sprites/plana umbrella.png';

    context.drawImage(getWhiteSprite(character.image), crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,

    context.globalAlpha = opacity;
  }

    context.strokeStyle = '#e54b93';
    context.strokeRect(drawX, drawY, width, height);
  }
  context.restore();
}

/** Draw animation poses with a short blend when entering/leaving boss actions. */
function drawCharacter(character) {
  if (character.death && character.lastPose && !character.animationFrames) {
    drawPose(character, character.lastPose, 1);
    return;
    point.x += camera.x;
    point.y += camera.y;
    if (mode === 'cursor') spawnBatch(point);
    else {
      const closest = records().filter(npc =>
        Math.hypot(npc.x - point.x, npc.y - point.y) < (npc.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2
      ).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - point.x, a.y - point.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - point.x, b.y - point.y))[0];
      if (closest) {
        selectedId = closest.id;
        if (mode === 'delete') removeEnemy(selectedId);
        refresh();
      }

import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03 },
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.38, y: 0.04 },
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.43, y: 0 }
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + size * profile.y,
    rx: size * profile.rx, ry: size * profile.ry };
}

/** Test a blade segment against an ellipse in normalized body coordinates. */
export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  const x = (x1 - body.x) / body.rx, y = (y1 - body.y) / body.ry;
  const dx = (x2 - x1) / body.rx, dy = (y2 - y1) / body.ry;
  const length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const t = length ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -(x * dx + y * dy) / length)) : 0;
  return (x + dx * t) ** 2 + (y + dy * t) ** 2 <= 1;
}

VERBATIM FILE CHANGE | D:\code\AI Applications\TERM Project\Development\combat-stats.js | content:
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.
export const defaultCombatStats = { atkPercent: 0, spdPercent: 0, critPercent: 0, pickupPercent: 0, hastePercent: 0 };

/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  return 1 + Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0) / 100;
}

/** Roll critical hits per enemy hit; critical damage is twice normal damage. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, baseDamage, random = Math.random) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const critical = random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent)) / 100;
  return { damage: Math.max(1, Math.round(baseDamage * statMultiplier(character, 'atkPercent') * (critical ? 2 : 1))), critical };
}

// Visual remnants are separate from living NPCs: no AI, collisions, or rewards.
const deaths = new Map();
const gachaEffects = new Map();
let gachaIcon;
export const deathSettings = { duration: 0.38, fadeStart: 0.12, distance: 48 };
export const gachaSettings = { rise: 0.24, hold: 0.1, pop: 0.16, width: 38 };

/** Load the supplied gacha artwork before the preview begins. */
export function loadEnemyDeathGraphics() {
  gachaIcon = new Image();
  gachaIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/MP_Gacha.png';
  return gachaIcon.decode();
}

/** Calculate a fast eased rise, brief stop, then expansion and disappearance. */
export function gachaPose(effect) {
  const rise = Math.min(1, effect.elapsed / gachaSettings.rise);
  const pop = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    (effect.elapsed - gachaSettings.rise - gachaSettings.hold) / gachaSettings.pop));
  return { x: effect.x, y: effect.y - effect.height * (1 - (1 - rise) ** 3),
    scale: 0.75 + 0.25 * rise + 0.65 * pop,
    opacity: 1 - pop, behind: rise < 0.55 };
}
// Persistent-in-session enemy state is separate from disposable background tiles.
// Future enemy spawning should register world coordinates here, never screen X/Y.
import { dropEnemyExp, dropEnemyLoot } from './exp-drops.js';
import { beginEnemyDeath } from './enemy-death.js';
import { showDamageNumber } from './damage-numbers.js';

const enemies = new Map();

/** Return all session records, including enemies outside the camera view. */
export function getAllEnemies() {
  return [...enemies.values()];
}

/** Explicitly clear the test population without affecting player state. */
export function clearEnemies() {
  enemies.clear();
}

/** Add or update an enemy's state without tying its lifetime to camera visibility. */
export function rememberEnemy(id, state) {
  const enemy = { ...enemies.get(id), ...state, id };
  enemies.set(id, enemy);
  return enemy;
}

/** Read a remembered enemy even after its background tile has left the screen. */
export function getEnemy(id) {
  return enemies.get(id);
}

/** Apply damage and trigger a brief sprite pulse; remove defeated test enemies. */
export function damageEnemy(id, amount, source) {
  const enemy = enemies.get(id);
  if (!enemy || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - amount);
  showDamageNumber(enemy, amount); // Show full hit damage, including lethal overkill.
  enemy.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
  if (enemy.hp === 0) {
    dropEnemyExp(enemy);
    dropEnemyLoot(enemy);
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source);
    enemies.delete(id);
  }
  return enemy;
}

/** Return enemies near the viewport for future rendering; retain all other records. */
export function getVisibleEnemies(cameraX, viewportWidth, margin = 160) {
  return [...enemies.values()].filter(enemy =>
    enemy.x >= cameraX - margin &&
    enemy.x <= cameraX + viewportWidth + margin
  );
}

export const playtestSpawnSettings = { perSecond: 10, offscreenMargin: 100, placementAttempts: 30 };

/** Choose an offscreen entrance compatible with the current map's playable axis. */
export function offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, width, height, random = Math.random) {
  const margin = playtestSpawnSettings.offscreenMargin; // Clears even a 168px elite.
  const between = (low, high) => low <= high ? low + random() * (high - low) : null;
  if (stage.axis === 'horizontal') {
    const y = between(camera.y + (stage.topPadding || 0) + margin,
      camera.y + height - (stage.bottomPadding || 0) - margin);
    return y === null ? null : { x: random() < 0.5 ? camera.x - margin : camera.x + width + margin, y };
  }
  if (stage.axis === 'vertical') {
    const x = between(camera.x + width * (stage.leftWallRatio || 0) + margin,
      camera.x + width * (stage.rightWallRatio ?? 1) - margin);
    return x === null ? null : { x, y: random() < 0.5 ? camera.y - margin : camera.y + height + margin };
  }
  const side = Math.floor(random() * 4);
  if (side < 2) return { x: camera.x + random() * width,
    y: side === 0 ? camera.y - margin : camera.y + height + margin };
  return { x: side === 2 ? camera.x - margin : camera.x + width + margin,
    y: camera.y + random() * height };
}

/** Run capped one-second spawn batches; stopping affects new spawns only. */
export function createPlaytestSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnEnemy, slotsRemaining, onBatch }) {
  const button = document.querySelector('#toggle-random-spawning');
  const status = document.querySelector('#random-spawn-status');
  let running = true;
  let elapsed = 0;

  /** Keep the sidebar button explicit about the next available action. */
  function updateControls(message = '') {
    button.textContent = running ? 'Stop random spawning' : 'Start random spawning';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(running));
    status.textContent = `${running ? 'Spawning' : 'Stopped'}: ${playtestSpawnSettings.perSecond} enemies/second. ${message}`;
  }
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    running = !running;
    elapsed = 0;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Validate offscreen attempts using the same map collisions as manual NPC spawns. */
  function update(delta) {
    if (!running) return;
    elapsed += delta;
    if (elapsed < 1) return;
    elapsed %= 1;
    let spawned = 0;
    const stage = getStage();
    for (let i = 0; i < playtestSpawnSettings.perSecond && slotsRemaining() > 0; i++) {
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
        const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        if (!point) break;
        if (spawnEnemy(point.x, point.y)) { spawned++; break; }
      }
    }
    onBatch();
    updateControls(`${spawned} spawned last batch.${slotsRemaining() === 0 ? ' Population limit reached.' : ''}`);
  }
  updateControls();
  return { update };
}

// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.
export const defaultCombatStats = { atkPercent: 0, spdPercent: 0, critPercent: 0, pickupPercent: 0, hastePercent: 0 };

/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  return 1 + Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0) / 100;
}

/** Roll critical hits per enemy hit; critical damage is twice normal damage. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, baseDamage, random = Math.random) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const critical = random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent)) / 100;
  return { damage: Math.max(1, Math.round(baseDamage * statMultiplier(character, 'atkPercent') * (critical ? 2 : 1))), critical };
}
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

export const damageNumberSettings = {
  duration: 0.55, fadeStart: 0.235,
  jumpHeight: 14.0625, // Half the previous 28.125px bounce; independent of duration.
  maxCount: 256
};
const numbers = [];
const textCache = new Map();
let font;

/** Load one shared bitmap font for all damage numbers. */
export function loadDamageNumberGraphics() {
  font = new Image();
  font.src = '../sprites/font.png';
  return font.decode();
}

/** Queue actual HP lost at the hit position; zero/invalid damage has no popup. */
export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false) {
  if (!(amount > 0) || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
  numbers.push({ text: String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100), player, elapsed: 0,
    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
    drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
}

/** Calculate the upward bounce, downward fall, and gradual end fade. */
export function damageNumberPose(number) {
  const t = number.elapsed;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t / damageNumberSettings.duration));
  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,
    y: number.y - 4 * damageNumberSettings.jumpHeight * progress * (1 - progress),
    opacity: 1 - fade * fade };
}

/** Expire popups even when their targets die or leave the viewport. */
export function updateDamageNumbers(delta) {
  for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    numbers[i].elapsed += delta;
    if (numbers[i].elapsed >= damageNumberSettings.duration) numbers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/** Cache compact bitmap numbers; red tint preserves the font's dark outline. */
function numberGraphic(text, red) {
  const key = `${text}:${red}`;
  if (textCache.has(key)) return textCache.get(key);
  const glyphs = [...text].map(letter => fontMetrics[letter] || fontMetrics['?']);
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = glyphs.reduce((sum, glyph) => sum + glyph.width - 1, 1);
  canvas.height = 20;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let x = 0;
  for (const glyph of glyphs) {
    context.drawImage(font, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
      x, glyph.offsetY, glyph.width, glyph.height);
    x += glyph.width - 1;
  }
  if (red) {
    const mask = document.createElement('canvas');
    mask.width = canvas.width;
    mask.height = canvas.height;
    mask.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    context.fillStyle = '#ff5265';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
    context.drawImage(mask, 0, 0);
  }
  if (textCache.size >= 128) textCache.delete(textCache.keys().next().value);
  textCache.set(key, canvas);
  return canvas;
}

/** Draw world-anchored numbers above actors, leaving the HUD unaffected. */
export function drawDamageNumbers(context, camera, width, height) {
  if (!font?.naturalWidth) return;
  context.save();
  context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  for (const number of numbers) {
    const pose = damageNumberPose(number);
    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
    if (x < -100 || y < -50 || x > width + 100 || y > height + 50) continue;
    const graphic = numberGraphic(number.text, number.player);
    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
    context.drawImage(graphic, x - graphic.width * 0.625, y, graphic.width * 1.25, 25);
  }
  context.restore();
}

// PLAYAREA SETTINGS: background height matches the internal screen height.
// The level is infinite horizontally. Only intersecting tiles are drawn each frame;
// no tile objects or off-screen canvases are retained. Camera Y stays 0.
// EDIT topMovementPadding to restrict the top edge if needed (canvas pixels).
// Zero allows walking into the window area; the sprite stays inside the screen.
const topMovementPadding = 0;
// EDIT bottomMovementPadding to reserve space below the sprite (canvas pixels).
// Names are no longer drawn, so no extra label space is needed at the bottom.
const bottomMovementPadding = 0;
const camera = { x: 0, y: 0 };
const maps = {
  first: { originX: 0, originY: 0, label: 'Playarea', axis: 'horizontal', source: '../sprites/Playarea.png', image: null },
  second: { originX: 0, originY: 0, label: 'Playarea 2', axis: 'vertical', source: '../sprites/Playarea 2.png', image: null,
    leftWallRatio: 0.12, rightWallRatio: 0.88 },
  third: { label: 'Playarea 3', axis: 'both',
    tiles: Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => ({ source: `../sprites/playarea 3/playarea 3-${index + 1}.png` })) },
  fourth: { label: 'Playarea 4', axis: 'island', source: '../sprites/play area 4.png', image: null,
    originX: 0, originY: 0, placed: false } // EDIT inner wall edges as image-width ratios.
