let currentMap = 'first';
const cameraAnchor = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
const cameraRecenterSpeed = 2.5; // EDIT catch-up rate: lower gives gentler, slower centering.
const mapTransition = authorized ? createMapTransition(canvas) : null;

/** Switch only the background/scrolling axis; entities keep their world positions. */
function switchMap() {
  if (!mapTransition || mapTransition.active || !maps.second.image) return;
  // Snapshot BACKGROUND ONLY. Characters, NPCs, and aim graphics are drawn later.
  context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  drawPlayarea();
  const outgoingMap = currentMap;
  mapTransition.begin(layer => drawPlayarea(layer, outgoingMap));
  const player = characters[selected];
  // Retain the current camera origin and player screen position on the new axis.
  cameraAnchor.x = player.x - camera.x;
  cameraAnchor.y = player.y - camera.y;
  const mapOrder = ['first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth'];
  currentMap = mapOrder[(mapOrder.indexOf(currentMap) + 1) % mapOrder.length];
  if (currentMap === 'fourth' && !maps.fourth.placed) {
    // Anchor the island's open central plaza under the player on first entry.
    // This positions the MAP, preserving existing player/NPC world coordinates.
    maps.fourth.originX = player.x - 740 * islandScale;
    maps.fourth.originY = player.y + (player.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2 - spritePadding - 620 * islandScale;
    maps.fourth.placed = true;
  }
  // Align the new map on its locked axis at the retained camera origin.
  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'vertical') maps[currentMap].originX = camera.x;
  else if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'horizontal') maps[currentMap].originY = camera.y;
  mapAudio?.setMap(currentMap);
  // Keep held inputs, attack timers, AI and aiming live throughout the transition.
  document.querySelector('#switch-map').textContent = `Switch map (current: ${maps[currentMap].label})`;
}

document.querySelector('#switch-map').addEventListener('click', switchMap);

/** Reset character positions and horizontal camera without changing sprite settings. */
function resetScene() {
  umbrellaAttack?.reset();
  aiming?.reset();
  releaseControls();
  for (const character of Object.values(characters)) {
    character.x = canvas.width * 0.4;
    character.y = canvas.height * 0.6;
    if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
      character.x = maps.fourth.originX + 740 * islandScale;
      character.y = maps.fourth.originY + 620 * islandScale - (character.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2 + spritePadding;
    }
    character.direction = character.defaultDirection || 'down';
    if (character.horizontalFacingOnly) character.facing = character.direction;
    character.elapsed = 0;
    character.moving = false;
    character.attack = null;
    character.transition = null;
  }
  camera.x = 0;
  camera.y = 0;
  updateAttackControls();
}

/** Follow the active character through positive and negative world coordinates. */
function updateCamera(delta = 0) {
  // Ease the retained screen anchor toward center after changing map axes.
  // World coordinates never change; the entire scene follows the same camera.
  const blend = 1 - Math.exp(-cameraRecenterSpeed * delta);
  if (maps[currentMap].axis !== 'vertical') {
    cameraAnchor.x += (canvas.width / 2 - cameraAnchor.x) * blend;
  }
  if (maps[currentMap].axis !== 'horizontal') {
    cameraAnchor.y += (canvas.height / 2 - cameraAnchor.y) * blend;
  }
  if (maps[currentMap].axis !== 'vertical') camera.x = characters[selected].x - cameraAnchor.x;
  if (maps[currentMap].axis !== 'horizontal') camera.y = characters[selected].y - cameraAnchor.y;
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
    const map = maps.fourth;
    camera.x = Math.max(map.originX, Math.min(map.originX + islandWidth - canvas.width, camera.x));
    camera.y = Math.max(map.originY, Math.min(map.originY + islandHeight - canvas.height, camera.y));
  }
}

/** Compute only visible tile indices, including negative indices left of origin. */
function getVisibleTileRange(cameraX, viewportWidth, tileWidth) {
  return {
    first: Math.floor(cameraX / tileWidth),
    last: Math.ceil((cameraX + viewportWidth) / tileWidth) - 1
  };
}

/** Render a bounded number of tiles from one shared image, however far we travel. */
function drawPlayarea(target = context, mapId = currentMap) {
  const map = maps[mapId];
  if (map.axis === 'island') {
    target.fillStyle = '#087fb9';
    target.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    drawIsland(target, map, camera);
    return;
  }
  if (map.axis === 'both') {
    drawTileWorld(target, map.tiles, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return;
  }
  const scale = map.axis === 'horizontal'
    ? canvas.height / map.image.naturalHeight
    : canvas.width / map.image.naturalWidth;
  const tileWidth = map.image.naturalWidth * scale;
  const tileHeight = map.image.naturalHeight * scale;
  const offsetX = camera.x - map.originX;
  const offsetY = camera.y - map.originY;
  const columns = getVisibleTileRange(offsetX, canvas.width, tileWidth);
  const rows = getVisibleTileRange(offsetY, canvas.height, tileHeight);
  // Normally only the map's scrolling axis changes. During a transition the
  // outgoing map also follows the new camera axis; visible repeats avoid gaps.
  for (let row = rows.first; row <= rows.last; row++) {
    for (let column = columns.first; column <= columns.last; column++) {
      const left = Math.round(column * tileWidth - offsetX);
      const top = Math.round(row * tileHeight - offsetY);
      const right = Math.round((column + 1) * tileWidth - offsetX);
      const bottom = Math.round((row + 1) * tileHeight - offsetY);
      target.drawImage(map.image, left, top, right - left, bottom - top);
    }
  }
  const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
  const step = movementSpeed * (character.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(character, 'spdPercent') * delta;
  const distance = (chaseTarget ? Math.min(step, length) : step) / (length || 1);
  const previousX = character.x;
  const previousY = character.y;
  character.x += x * distance;
  character.y += y * distance;
  if (chaseTarget && step >= length) {
    character.x = chaseTarget.x;
    character.y = chaseTarget.y;
  }
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
    const resolved = resolveIslandMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y, maps.fourth);
    character.x = resolved.x;
    character.y = resolved.y;
    return;
  }
  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'both') {
    const resolved = resolveObstacleMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y);
    character.x = resolved.x;
    character.y = resolved.y;
    return;
  }
  // Test enemies can reach the player's center even when their larger sprite
  // would hit a viewport edge first. Player movement retains map wall limits.
  if (chaseTarget && character !== characters[selected]) return;
  // Neither map's locked-axis limits should interrupt diagonal input while the
  // backgrounds are changing. Apply destination walls only after the ripple.
  // Existing outside positions are preserved by constrainWithoutTeleport below.
  if (mapTransition?.active) return;
  const margin = (character.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2;
  // X is an unbounded world position, not a canvas position. Never wrap it:
  // future enemy positions must remain stable when background tiles disappear.
  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'horizontal') {
    const top = camera.y + topMovementPadding + margin;
    const bottom = camera.y + canvas.height - margin - bottomMovementPadding;
    // Off-screen NPCs must not teleport into the new viewport after a map switch.
    if (previousY >= top && previousY <= bottom) {
      character.y = Math.max(top, Math.min(bottom, character.y));
    }
  } else {
    const map = maps[currentMap];
    const player = character === characters[selected];
    const left = camera.x + canvas.width * (player ? map.leftWallRatio : 0) + margin;
    const right = camera.x + canvas.width * (player ? map.rightWallRatio : 1) - margin;
    if (player) {
      // Preserve position on map switch even if already outside the corridor.
      // Permit movement back inside, but never farther into/through the walls.
      character.x = constrainWithoutTeleport(previousX, character.x, left, right);
    } else if (previousX >= left && previousX <= right) {
      character.x = Math.max(left, Math.min(right, character.x));
    }
  }
}

/** Apply contact displacement through the same solid map collision as walking. */
function moveNpcBy(character, dx, dy) {
  const targetX = character.x + dx, targetY = character.y + dy;
  let result = { x: targetX, y: targetY };
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
    result = resolveIslandMotion(character, character.x, character.y, targetX, targetY, maps.fourth);
  } else if (currentMap === 'third') {
    result = resolveObstacleMotion(character, character.x, character.y, targetX, targetY);
export const playtestSpawnSettings = { perSecond: 5, offscreenMargin: 100, placementAttempts: 30 };

/** Choose an offscreen entrance compatible with the current map's playable axis. */
export function offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, width, height, random = Math.random) {
  const margin = playtestSpawnSettings.offscreenMargin; // Clears even a 168px elite.
  const between = (low, high) => low <= high ? low + random() * (high - low) : null;
  if (stage.axis === 'horizontal') {
    const y = between(camera.y + (stage.topPadding || 0) + margin,
      camera.y + height - (stage.bottomPadding || 0) - margin);
    return y === null ? null : { x: random() < 0.5 ? camera.x - margin : camera.x + width + margin, y };
  }
  if (stage.axis === 'vertical') {
    const x = between(camera.x + width * (stage.leftWallRatio || 0) + margin,
      camera.x + width * (stage.rightWallRatio ?? 1) - margin);
    return x === null ? null : { x, y: random() < 0.5 ? camera.y - margin : camera.y + height + margin };
  }
  const side = Math.floor(random() * 4);
  if (side < 2) return { x: camera.x + random() * width,
    y: side === 0 ? camera.y - margin : camera.y + height + margin };
  return { x: side === 2 ? camera.x - margin : camera.x + width + margin,
    y: camera.y + random() * height };
}

  }

/** Keep one world/canvas pixel equal to one displayed CSS pixel on any screen. */
export function observeViewport(canvas, onResize = () => {}) {
  function resize() {
    const rectangle = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rectangle.width));
    const height = Math.max(1, Math.round(rectangle.height));
    if (canvas.width === width && canvas.height === height) return;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    onResize();
  }
  const observer = new ResizeObserver(resize);
  observer.observe(canvas);
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => observer.disconnect(), { once: true });
  return observer;
}
import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';

export const eliteChance = 0.03;

/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random) {
  const elite = type === 'mob' && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteChance));
  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite ? 1.5 : 1),
    hp: elite ? 500 : 100,
    maxHp: elite ? 500 : 100,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1
  };
}

/** Apply contact displacement through the same solid map collision as walking. */
function moveNpcBy(character, dx, dy) {
  const targetX = character.x + dx, targetY = character.y + dy;
  let result = { x: targetX, y: targetY };
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
    result = resolveIslandMotion(character, character.x, character.y, targetX, targetY, maps.fourth);
  } else if (currentMap === 'third') {
    result = resolveObstacleMotion(character, character.x, character.y, targetX, targetY);
  }
  character.x = result.x;
  character.y = result.y;
}

/** Return a source rectangle using the sheet's uneven per-column row boundaries. */
function getFrameRectangle(character, frame) {
  const facing = character.horizontalFacingOnly ? character.facing : character.direction;
  const row = character.attack
    ? character.attacks[character.attack.name].rows[character.attack.facing]
    : !character.moving && character.idleRows?.[facing] !== undefined
    ? character.idleRows[facing]
    : character.rows[facing];
  // Attack artwork can exceed the grid cell. Custom rectangles keep the tank's
  // anchor fixed even when a muzzle flash needs a wider crop.
/** Radial stagger plus checkerboard parity gives each tile its own shrink phase. */
export function shrinkProgress(elapsed, column, row, columns, rows) {
  const radius = Math.hypot(column - (columns - 1) / 2, row - (rows - 1) / 2);
  const delay = radius * 45 + ((column + row) % 2) * 55;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (elapsed - delay) / 420));
}

  [[1030, 25, 1425, 330], [165, 725, 370, 910]],
  [[1020, 95, 1300, 345], [870, 480, 1040, 665], [170, 755, 400, 950]],
  [[1040, 110, 1290, 350], [175, 735, 325, 915]],
  [[930, 175, 1160, 370], [230, 410, 455, 600], [875, 695, 1060, 850]],
  [[1020, 95, 1300, 345], [165, 300, 365, 470], [795, 475, 1060, 685], [170, 755, 400, 950]],
  [[735, 95, 1055, 300], [185, 270, 400, 455], [1040, 515, 1315, 770], [260, 715, 495, 895]]
];

/** Produce a stable weighted tile index for positive or negative grid coordinates. */
export function tileIndex(column, row, seed = worldSeed) {
  let hash = Math.imul(column | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(row | 0, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 16), 0x7feb352d);
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 15), 0x846ca68b);
  hash = (hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0;
  let value = hash / 4294967296 * tileWeights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < tileWeights.length; i++) {
    value -= tileWeights[i];
    if (value < 0) return i;
  }
  return tileWeights.length - 1;
}

/** Query obstacle rectangles only for tiles touched by a local world region. */
export function obstaclesIn(left, top, right, bottom) {
  const rectangles = [];
  for (let row = Math.floor((top - tileOverlap) / tileStrideY); row <= Math.floor(bottom / tileStrideY); row++) {
    for (let column = Math.floor((left - tileOverlap) / tileStrideX); column <= Math.floor(right / tileStrideX); column++) {
      for (const box of obstacleBoxes[tileIndex(column, row)]) {
        rectangles.push({
          left: column * tileStrideX + box[0] * sourceScale,
          top: row * tileStrideY + box[1] * sourceScale,
          right: column * tileStrideX + box[2] * sourceScale,
          bottom: row * tileStrideY + box[3] * sourceScale
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return rectangles;
}

/** Use a small foot-level rectangle for collision rather than transparent sprite padding. */
function footprint(character, x, y) {
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const halfWidth = size * 0.14;
  const halfHeight = size * 0.06;
  const groundY = y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
  return { left: x - halfWidth, right: x + halfWidth, top: groundY - halfHeight, bottom: groundY + halfHeight };
}

/** Return penetration depth; zero means no overlap. */
function penetration(a, b) {
  if (a.right <= b.left || a.left >= b.right || a.bottom <= b.top || a.top >= b.bottom) return 0;
  return Math.min(a.right - b.left, b.right - a.left, a.bottom - b.top, b.bottom - a.top);
}

/** Validate random/cursor placement without creating NPCs inside obstacles. */
export function canStand(character, x, y) {
  const body = footprint(character, x, y);
  return obstaclesIn(body.left, body.top, body.right, body.bottom).every(box => !penetration(body, box));
}

/** Substep motion and slide along blocked axes, preventing diagonal tunneling. */
export function resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY) {
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(toX - fromX), Math.abs(toY - fromY)) / 8));
  const dx = (toX - fromX) / steps, dy = (toY - fromY) / steps;
  let x = fromX, y = fromY;
  const permitted = (nextX, nextY) => {
    const before = footprint(character, x, y);
    const after = footprint(character, nextX, nextY);
    return obstaclesIn(after.left, after.top, after.right, after.bottom).every(box => {
      const depth = penetration(after, box);
      // Switching maps preserves positions. If already inside a new obstacle,
      // allow escape motions that reduce overlap instead of teleporting the actor.
      const oldDepth = penetration(before, box);
      const centerX = (box.left + box.right) / 2;
      const centerY = (box.top + box.bottom) / 2;
      const distanceBefore = Math.hypot((before.left + before.right) / 2 - centerX,
        (before.top + before.bottom) / 2 - centerY);
      const distanceAfter = Math.hypot((after.left + after.right) / 2 - centerX,
        (after.top + after.bottom) / 2 - centerY);
      return !depth || (oldDepth > 0 && (depth < oldDepth || distanceAfter > distanceBefore));
    });
  };
  for (let step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
    if (permitted(x + dx, y)) x += dx;
    if (permitted(x, y + dy)) y += dy;
  }
  return { x, y };
}

/** Draw only visible seeded tiles; generation allocates no persistent tile cache. */
export function drawTileWorld(context, images, camera, width, height, debug = false) {
  for (let row = Math.floor((camera.y - tileOverlap) / tileStrideY); row <= Math.floor((camera.y + height) / tileStrideY); row++) {
    for (let column = Math.floor((camera.x - tileOverlap) / tileStrideX); column <= Math.floor((camera.x + width) / tileStrideX); column++) {
      const x = Math.round(column * tileStrideX - camera.x);
      const y = Math.round(row * tileStrideY - camera.y);
      const right = Math.round(column * tileStrideX + tileWidth - camera.x);
      const bottom = Math.round(row * tileStrideY + tileHeight - camera.y);
      context.drawImage(images[tileIndex(column, row)].image, x, y, right - x, bottom - y);
    }
  }

// EDIT map zoom independently of actor sizes. All stages use this multiplier.
export const mapSizeMultiplier = 1.5;

/** Physical playable limits for the enlarged horizontal/vertical strip maps. */
export function stripMapBounds(map, width, height, topPadding = 0, bottomPadding = 0) {
  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') return {
    left: -Infinity, right: Infinity,
    top: map.originY + topPadding,
    bottom: map.originY + height * mapSizeMultiplier - bottomPadding
  };
  return {
    left: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.leftWallRatio || 0),
    right: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.rightWallRatio ?? 1),
    top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity
  };
}

/** Stop the camera at finite edges while leaving the long map axis infinite. */
export function clampStripCamera(map, camera, width, height) {
  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') camera.y = Math.max(map.originY,
    Math.min(map.originY + height * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.y));
  if (map.axis === 'vertical') camera.x = Math.max(map.originX,
    Math.min(map.originX + width * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.x));
}

/** Follow the active character through positive and negative world coordinates. */
function updateCamera(delta = 0) {
  // Ease the retained screen anchor toward center after changing map axes.
  // World coordinates never change; the entire scene follows the same camera.
  const blend = 1 - Math.exp(-cameraRecenterSpeed * delta);

  cameraAnchor.y += (canvas.height / 2 - cameraAnchor.y) * blend;

}

/** Keep one world/canvas pixel equal to one displayed CSS pixel on any screen. */
export function observeViewport(canvas, onResize = () => {}) {
  function resize() {
    const rectangle = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rectangle.width));
    const height = Math.max(1, Math.round(rectangle.height));
    if (canvas.width === width && canvas.height === height) return;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    onResize();
  }
  const observer = new ResizeObserver(resize);
  observer.observe(canvas);
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => observer.disconnect(), { once: true });
  return observer;
}

/** Expand only the play area to the browser viewport, preserving the live session. */
export function setupFullscreenPreview(canvas, releaseControls) {
  const enter = document.querySelector('#enter-fullscreen-preview');
  const exit = document.querySelector('#exit-fullscreen-preview');
  const layout = document.querySelector('.playtest-layout');
  const main = document.querySelector('#development-content');
  const sidebar = document.querySelector('.playtest-sidebar');
  let active = false;
  let previousInert = [];

  /** Resize via CSS/ResizeObserver; never scale actors or reset world positions. */
  function setFullscreen(enabled) {
    if (active === enabled) return;
    active = enabled;
    releaseControls();
    document.body.classList.toggle('fullscreen-preview', active);
    enter.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
    exit.hidden = !active;
    if (active) {
      // Background admin controls should not receive hidden keyboard focus.
      const controls = [...main.children].filter(element => element !== layout).concat(sidebar);
      previousInert = controls.map(element => [element, element.inert]);
      for (const [element] of previousInert) element.inert = true;
      canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } else {
      for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
      previousInert = [];
      enter.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }

  enter.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(true));
  exit.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(false));
  window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (active && event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      setFullscreen(false);
    }
  });
}

/** Expand only the play area to the browser viewport, preserving the live session. */
export function setupFullscreenPreview(canvas, releaseControls) {
  const enter = document.querySelector('#enter-fullscreen-preview');
  const exit = document.querySelector('#exit-fullscreen-preview');
  const layout = document.querySelector('.playtest-layout');
  const main = document.querySelector('#development-content');
  const sidebar = document.querySelector('.playtest-sidebar');
  let active = false;
  let previousInert = [];

  /** Resize via CSS/ResizeObserver; never scale actors or reset world positions. */
  function setFullscreen(enabled) {
    if (active === enabled) return;
    active = enabled;
    releaseControls();
    document.body.classList.toggle('fullscreen-preview', active);
    enter.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
    exit.hidden = !active;
    if (active) {
      // Background admin controls should not receive hidden keyboard focus.
      const controls = [...main.children].filter(element => element !== layout).concat(sidebar);
      previousInert = controls.map(element => [element, element.inert]);
      for (const [element] of previousInert) element.inert = true;
      canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } else {
      for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
      previousInert = [];
      enter.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }

  enter.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(true));
  exit.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(false));
  window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (active && event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      setFullscreen(false);
    }
  });
}
  padding: 18px;
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid #b5dcec;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

/** Run capped one-second spawn batches; stopping affects new spawns only. */
export function createPlaytestSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnEnemy, slotsRemaining, onBatch }) {
  const button = document.querySelector('#toggle-random-spawning');
  const status = document.querySelector('#random-spawn-status');
  let running = true;
  let elapsed = 0;

  /** Keep the sidebar button explicit about the next available action. */
  function updateControls(message = '') {
    button.textContent = running ? 'Stop random spawning' : 'Start random spawning';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(running));
    status.textContent = `${running ? 'Spawning' : 'Stopped'}: ${playtestSpawnSettings.perSecond} enemies/second. ${message}`;
  }
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    running = !running;
    elapsed = 0;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Validate offscreen attempts using the same map collisions as manual NPC spawns. */
  function update(delta) {
    if (!running) return;
    elapsed += delta;
    if (elapsed < 1) return;
    elapsed %= 1;
    let spawned = 0;
    const stage = getStage();
    for (let i = 0; i < playtestSpawnSettings.perSecond && slotsRemaining() > 0; i++) {
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
        const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        if (!point) break;
        if (spawnEnemy(point.x, point.y)) { spawned++; break; }
      }
    }
    onBatch();
    updateControls(`${spawned} spawned last batch.${slotsRemaining() === 0 ? ' Population limit reached.' : ''}`);
  }
  updateControls();
  return { update };
}

/** Update and render only the active avatar; the inactive character stays hidden. */
function animate(time) {
  const delta = previousTime === undefined ? 0 : Math.min((time - previousTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  previousTime = time;
  mapAudio?.update(delta);
  updateDamageNumbers(delta);
  playerStatsTools?.update();
  advanceDamageFlash(characters[selected], delta);
  hud?.update(characters[selected]);
  const direction = getMovementDirection();
  const activeCharacter = characters[selected];
  if (activeCharacter.animationFrames) activeCharacter.gifElapsed = (activeCharacter.gifElapsed || 0) + delta * 1000;
  if (activeCharacter.transition) activeCharacter.transition.elapsed += delta * 1000;
  const playerBefore = { x: activeCharacter.x, y: activeCharacter.y };
  updateCharacter(activeCharacter, delta, direction);
  const playerMotion = { x: activeCharacter.x - playerBefore.x, y: activeCharacter.y - playerBefore.y };
  updateCamera(delta);
  playtestSpawner?.update(delta);
  npcTools?.update(delta, playerMotion);
  const facing = activeCharacter.horizontalFacingOnly
    ? activeCharacter.facing : activeCharacter.direction;
  const aimAngle = aiming.getAngle(activeCharacter, camera.x, directionVectors[facing], camera.y);
  umbrellaAttack?.update(delta, activeCharacter, aimAngle);
  expPickups?.update(activeCharacter, playerBefore, delta);
  hud?.update(activeCharacter);
  context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  drawPlayarea();
  mapTransition?.draw(context, delta);
  if (currentMap === 'fourth' && showSpriteBounds) drawIsland(context, maps.fourth, camera, true);
  if (currentMap === 'third' && showSpriteBounds) {
    context.save();
    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
    for (const box of obstaclesIn(camera.x, camera.y, camera.x + canvas.width, camera.y + canvas.height)) {
      context.strokeRect(box.left - camera.x, box.top - camera.y, box.right - box.left, box.bottom - box.top);
    }
    context.restore();
  }
  expPickups?.draw(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  npcTools?.draw(context);
  drawCharacter(activeCharacter);
  umbrellaAttack?.draw(context, camera);
  drawDamageNumbers(context, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  aiming?.draw(context, activeCharacter, camera.x, directionVectors[facing], camera.y);
  document.querySelector('#switch-map').disabled = Boolean(mapTransition?.active);

  const action = activeCharacter.attack
    ? activeCharacter.attacks[activeCharacter.attack.name].label
    : direction || 'idle';
  const description = `${activeCharacter.label} / ${action} / camera X ${Math.round(camera.x)} / Y ${Math.round(camera.y)} / ${maps[currentMap].label}`;
  if (status.textContent !== description) status.textContent = description;
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3 } = {}) {
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const characters = [...text];
    const advances = characters.map(character => character === ' '
      ? spaceWidth : glyphRectangle(character).width - outlineOverlap);
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, (advances.reduce((sum, width) => sum + width, 0) + outlineOverlap) * scale);
    canvas.height = 20 * scale;
    canvas.style.width = `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    let x = 0;
    for (const [index, character] of characters.entries()) {
      if (character !== ' ') {
        const glyph = glyphRectangle(character);
        context.drawImage(image, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
          x * scale, glyph.offsetY * scale, glyph.width * scale, glyph.height * scale);
      }
      x += advances[index];
    }
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = '../sprites/font.png';
  return {
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}

/** Clear held input when focus is lost so characters cannot get stuck moving. */
function releaseControls() {
  heldDirections.clear();
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
  // Let admin form fields use their own arrow keys and text input.
  if (event.target?.closest('input, select, textarea')) return;
  const direction = directionForKey(event.key);
  if (!direction) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  if (!event.repeat) heldDirections.set(event.code, direction);
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', event => {
  heldDirections.delete(event.code);
});

window.addEventListener('blur', releaseControls);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', releaseControls);

export function createPauseMenu({ canvas, getPlayer, releaseControls }) {
  const overlay = document.querySelector('#pause-menu');
  const resume = document.querySelector('#pause-resume');
  const pauseButton = document.querySelector('#pause-game');
  const portrait = document.querySelector('#pause-portrait');

  createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#pause-title'), { scale: 2 }).setText('PAUSED');

  const settings = document.querySelector('#pause-settings');
  const volume = document.querySelector('#pause-music-volume');
  const mainVolume = document.querySelector('#music-volume');
  const volumeValue = document.querySelector('#pause-volume-value');

  let previousInert = [];

    row.className = 'pause-stat-row';
    const icon = document.createElement('img');
    icon.alt = '';
    if (label === 'SPD') icon.addEventListener('error', () => { icon.src = whistleFallback; }, { once: true });

    const valueCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const labelText = createBitmapText(labelCanvas, { scale: 1.1 });
    const valueText = createBitmapText(valueCanvas, { scale: 1.1 });
    labelText.setText(label);
    row.append(icon, labelCanvas, valueCanvas);
    container.append(row);
    return { value, valueText };
  });

  /** Refresh values and the holographic portrait for the controlled character. */
  function refresh() {
    const character = ensurePlayerStats(getPlayer());
    name.setText(character.label.toUpperCase());
    for (const row of rows) row.valueText.setText(row.value(character));
    const label = character.label.toLowerCase();
    const source = label.includes('plana') ? '../sprites/Plana_Portrait.png'
      : label.includes('arona') ? '../sprites/Arona_Portrait.png' : '';
    portrait.hidden = !source;
    if (source) portrait.src = source;
    document.querySelector('#pause-exit-preview').hidden = !document.body.classList.contains('fullscreen-preview');
    volume.value = mainVolume.value;
    volumeValue.textContent = `${volume.value}%`;
  }

  /** Preserve the session and prevent hidden developer controls changing it while paused. */
  function setPaused(enabled) {
    if (paused === enabled) return;
    paused = enabled;
    releaseControls();
    overlay.hidden = !paused;
    pauseButton.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(paused));
    if (paused) {
      refresh();
      settings.hidden = true;
      document.querySelector('#pause-settings-toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      const main = document.querySelector('#development-content');
      const layout = document.querySelector('.playtest-layout');
      const blocked = [...main.children].filter(element => element !== layout)
        .concat(document.querySelector('.playtest-sidebar'), canvas, document.querySelector('#exit-fullscreen-preview'));
      previousInert = blocked.map(element => [element, element.inert]);
      for (const [element] of previousInert) element.inert = true;
      resume.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } else {
      for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
      previousInert = [];
      canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }

  pauseButton.addEventListener('click', () => setPaused(true));
  resume.addEventListener('click', () => setPaused(false));
  document.querySelector('#pause-settings-toggle').addEventListener('click', event => {
    settings.hidden = !settings.hidden;
    event.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!settings.hidden));
  });
  volume.addEventListener('input', () => {
    mainVolume.value = volume.value;
    mainVolume.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    volumeValue.textContent = `${volume.value}%`;
  });
  document.querySelector('#pause-exit-preview').addEventListener('click', () => {
    setPaused(false);
    document.querySelector('#exit-fullscreen-preview').click();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key !== 'Escape' || event.repeat) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    setPaused(!paused);
  }, true);
  return { get paused() { return paused; } };
}

export const playtestSpawnSettings = {
  perSecond: 5, crowdedPerSecond: 1, visibleLimit: 50,
  offscreenMargin: 100, placementAttempts: 30
};

/** Count enemies whose sprite area intersects the actual gameplay viewport. */
export function visibleEnemyCount(enemies, camera, width, height) {
  return enemies.filter(enemy => {
    const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || 112) / 2;
    return enemy.x + radius >= camera.x && enemy.x - radius <= camera.x + width &&
      enemy.y + radius >= camera.y && enemy.y - radius <= camera.y + height;
  }).length;
}

/** Choose an offscreen entrance compatible with the current map's playable axis. */
export function offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, width, height, random = Math.random) {
  const margin = playtestSpawnSettings.offscreenMargin; // Clears even a 168px elite.
  const between = (low, high) => low <= high ? low + random() * (high - low) : null;
  if (stage.axis === 'horizontal') {
    const y = between(Math.max(camera.y, stage.playableBounds?.top ?? camera.y + (stage.topPadding || 0)) + margin,
      Math.min(camera.y + height, stage.playableBounds?.bottom ?? camera.y + height - (stage.bottomPadding || 0)) - margin);
    return y === null ? null : { x: random() < 0.5 ? camera.x - margin : camera.x + width + margin, y };
  }
  if (stage.axis === 'vertical') {
    const x = between(Math.max(camera.x, stage.playableBounds?.left ?? camera.x + width * (stage.leftWallRatio || 0)) + margin,
      Math.min(camera.x + width, stage.playableBounds?.right ?? camera.x + width * (stage.rightWallRatio ?? 1)) - margin);
    return x === null ? null : { x, y: random() < 0.5 ? camera.y - margin : camera.y + height + margin };
  }
  const side = Math.floor(random() * 4);
  if (side < 2) return { x: camera.x + random() * width,
    y: side === 0 ? camera.y - margin : camera.y + height + margin };
  return { x: side === 2 ? camera.x - margin : camera.x + width + margin,
    y: camera.y + random() * height };
}

/** Run capped one-second spawn batches; stopping affects new spawns only. */
export function createPlaytestSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnEnemy, slotsRemaining, onBatch, getEnemies }) {
  const button = document.querySelector('#toggle-random-spawning');
  const status = document.querySelector('#random-spawn-status');
  let running = true;
  let elapsed = 0;
  let lastStatus = '';

  /** Slow new arrivals when the visible crowd reaches the testing threshold. */
  function crowdState() {
    const visible = visibleEnemyCount(getEnemies(), camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return { visible, rate: visible >= playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit
      ? playtestSpawnSettings.crowdedPerSecond : playtestSpawnSettings.perSecond };
  }

  /** Keep the sidebar button explicit about the next available action. */
  function updateControls(message = '') {
    button.textContent = running ? 'Stop random spawning' : 'Start random spawning';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(running));
    const crowd = crowdState();
    status.textContent = `${running ? 'Spawning' : 'Stopped'}: ${crowd.rate} enemies/second. On screen: ${crowd.visible}/${playtestSpawnSettings.visibleLimit}. ${message}`;
    lastStatus = `${running}:${crowd.rate}:${crowd.visible}`;
  }
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    running = !running;
    elapsed = 0;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Validate offscreen attempts using the same map collisions as manual NPC spawns. */
  function update(delta) {
    const crowd = crowdState();
    if (lastStatus !== `${running}:${crowd.rate}:${crowd.visible}`) updateControls();
    if (!running) return;
    elapsed += delta;
    if (elapsed < 1) return;
    elapsed %= 1;
    let spawned = 0;
    const stage = getStage();
    for (let i = 0; i < crowd.rate && slotsRemaining() > 0; i++) {
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < playtestSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
        const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        if (!point) break;
        if (spawnEnemy(point.x, point.y)) { spawned++; break; }
      }
    }
    onBatch();
    updateControls(`${spawned} spawned last batch.${slotsRemaining() === 0 ? ' Population limit reached.' : ''}`);
  }
  updateControls();
  return { update };
}

import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { mapSizeMultiplier } from './map-bounds.js';
// EDIT seed/weights to change generation. Coordinates, not visit order, select tiles.
export const worldSeed = 20261101;
export const tileWeights = [35, 23, 16, 11, 10, 5];
export const tileWidth = 960 * mapSizeMultiplier;
export const tileHeight = 720 * mapSizeMultiplier;
export const tileOverlap = 2; // EDIT shared edge overlap in world pixels to hide seams.
const tileStrideX = tileWidth - tileOverlap;
const tileStrideY = tileHeight - tileOverlap;
const sourceScale = tileWidth / 1448;

// EDIT obstacle rectangles in SOURCE IMAGE pixels: [left, top, right, bottom].
// These deliberately cover the obstacle artwork, excluding its cast shadow.
export const obstacleBoxes = [
  [[1030, 25, 1425, 330], [165, 725, 370, 910]],
  [[1020, 95, 1300, 345], [870, 480, 1040, 665], [170, 755, 400, 950]],
  [[1040, 110, 1290, 350], [175, 735, 325, 915]],
  [[930, 175, 1160, 370], [230, 410, 455, 600], [875, 695, 1060, 850]],
  [[1020, 95, 1300, 345], [165, 300, 365, 470], [795, 475, 1060, 685], [170, 755, 400, 950]],
  [[735, 95, 1055, 300], [185, 270, 400, 455], [1040, 515, 1315, 770], [260, 715, 495, 895]]
];

/** Produce a stable weighted tile index for positive or negative grid coordinates. */
export function tileIndex(column, row, seed = worldSeed) {
  let hash = Math.imul(column | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(row | 0, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;
  };
}

/** Render a bounded number of tiles from one shared image, however far we travel. */
function drawPlayarea(target = context, mapId = currentMap) {
  const map = maps[mapId];
  if (map.axis === 'island') {
    target.fillStyle = '#087fb9';
    target.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    drawIsland(target, map, camera);
    return;
  }
  if (map.axis === 'both') {
    drawTileWorld(target, map.tiles, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return;
  }
  const scale = map.axis === 'horizontal'
    ? canvas.height * mapSizeMultiplier / map.image.naturalHeight
    : canvas.width * mapSizeMultiplier / map.image.naturalWidth;
  const tileWidth = map.image.naturalWidth * scale;
  const tileHeight = map.image.naturalHeight * scale;
  const offsetX = camera.x - map.originX;
  const offsetY = camera.y - map.originY;
  const columns = getVisibleTileRange(offsetX, canvas.width, tileWidth);
  const rows = getVisibleTileRange(offsetY, canvas.height, tileHeight);
  // Only the long axis repeats. Outgoing transition layers may repeat for coverage.
  if (mapId === currentMap && map.axis === 'horizontal') rows.first = rows.last = 0;
  if (mapId === currentMap && map.axis === 'vertical') columns.first = columns.last = 0;
  // Normally only the map's scrolling axis changes. During a transition the
  // outgoing map also follows the new camera axis; visible repeats avoid gaps.
  for (let row = rows.first; row <= rows.last; row++) {
    for (let column = columns.first; column <= columns.last; column++) {
      const left = Math.round(column * tileWidth - offsetX);
      const top = Math.round(row * tileHeight - offsetY);
      const right = Math.round((column + 1) * tileWidth - offsetX);
      const bottom = Math.round((row + 1) * tileHeight - offsetY);
      target.drawImage(map.image, left, top, right - left, bottom - top);
    }
  }
}

// These controls live OUTSIDE the simulated screen, never over gameplay.
document.querySelector('#reset-scene').addEventListener('click', resetScene);
document.querySelector('#toggle-bounds').addEventListener('click', event => {
  showSpriteBounds = !showSpriteBounds;
  event.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(showSpriteBounds));
});
// Keep frequently used progression controls separate from the general admin panel.
if (authorized) {
  Promise.all([...Object.values(characters), ...Object.values(maps).filter(map => map.source), ...maps.third.tiles].map(loadSheet).concat(aiming.ready, expPickups.ready, loadEnemyDeathGraphics(), umbrellaAttack.ready, loadDamageNumberGraphics()))
    .then(() => {
      observeViewport(canvas, () => {
        mapTransition?.cancel();
        // Resize the view, never entity coordinates, sprite sizes, or map 3/4 scale.
        updateCamera();
      });
      resetScene();
      setupFullscreenPreview(canvas, releaseControls);
      updateAttackControls();
      setupSpriteTester(characters, switchCharacter);
      mapAudio = createMapAudio(currentMap);
      Object.values(characters).forEach(ensurePlayerStats);
      hud = createHud(getFrameRectangle);
      playerStatsTools = createPlayerStatsTools(() => characters[selected], character => hud.update(character));
      hud.update(characters[selected]);
      npcTools = createNpcTools({ canvas, characters, camera,
        getPlayer: () => characters[selected],
        isVertical: () => maps[currentMap].axis === 'vertical',
        isFreeScroll: () => currentMap === 'third' || currentMap === 'fourth',
        isPlacementClear: (character, x, y) => currentMap === 'fourth'
          ? canStandOnIsland(character, x, y, maps.fourth)
          : currentMap === 'third' ? canStand(character, x, y)
          : canSpawnInStrip(character, x, y, stripMapBounds(maps[currentMap], canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding)),
        updateCharacter, drawCharacter, moveNpcBy });
      playtestSpawner = createPlaytestSpawner({ canvas, camera,
        getStage: () => ({ ...maps[currentMap], topPadding: topMovementPadding, bottomPadding: bottomMovementPadding,
          playableBounds: stripMapBounds(maps[currentMap], canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding) }),
        spawnEnemy: npcTools.spawnEnemy, slotsRemaining: npcTools.slotsRemaining,
        onBatch: npcTools.refresh, getEnemies: npcTools.getEnemies, getPlayer: () => characters[selected] });
      pauseMenu = createPauseMenu({ canvas, getPlayer: () => characters[selected], releaseControls });
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    })
    .catch(error => { status.textContent = error.message; });
}

import { worldSeed, canStand, resolveObstacleMotion } from './tile-world.js';
import { mapSizeMultiplier } from './map-bounds.js';

export const officeTileFiles = [
  'Playarea.png', 'schale-office-single-clear-wall.png',
  'schale-office-single-frosted-wall.png', 'schale-office-single-monitor-desk.png',
  'schale-office-single-paperwork-desk.png', 'schale-office-mixed-three.png',
  'schale-office-variation-a.png', 'schale-office-variation-b.png',
  'schale-office-blue-archive-logo-monument.png'
];
export const officeTileWeights = [30, 12, 12, 12, 12, 10, 6, 6];
export const officeMonument = { chance: 0.03, pityDistance: 20, index: 8 };
const overlap = 2;

// EDIT obstacle rectangles in source-image pixels [left, top, right, bottom].
// Clear/frosted partitions, desk bodies and monument exclude cast shadows.
export const officeObstacleBoxes = [
  [],
  [[400, 470, 750, 550]],
  [[670, 505, 1070, 585]],
  [[605, 165, 845, 260]],
  [[585, 595, 870, 730]],
  [[265, 295, 455, 425], [895, 470, 1310, 570], [275, 675, 495, 815]],
  [[340, 300, 695, 415], [905, 470, 1140, 610], [475, 715, 865, 835]],
  [[325, 305, 560, 440], [880, 340, 1210, 440], [310, 715, 670, 825], [920, 715, 1160, 850]],
  [[90, 240, 1390, 705]]
];

/** Stable coordinate-based random values independent of exploration order. */
function officeRandom(column, salt, seed) {
  let hash = Math.imul(column | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(salt, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 16), 0x7feb352d);
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 15), 0x846ca68b);
  return ((hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}

/** Build deterministic left/right pity streams, caching only monument indices. */
export function createOfficeTileSelector(seed = worldSeed) {
  const streams = { left: [0], right: [0] }; // Zero is a virtual anchor, not a monument.
  return function tileAt(column) {
    if (column === 0) return 0; // Keep the starting office clear.
    const sign = column < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    const distance = Math.abs(column);
    const monuments = sign < 0 ? streams.left : streams.right;
    while (monuments[monuments.length - 1] < distance) {
      const previous = monuments[monuments.length - 1];
      let step = 1;
      for (; step < officeMonument.pityDistance; step++) {
        if (officeRandom(sign * (previous + step), 1, seed) < officeMonument.chance) break;
      }
      monuments.push(previous + step);
    }
    let low = 1, high = monuments.length - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
      if (monuments[mid] === distance) return officeMonument.index;
      if (monuments[mid] < distance) low = mid + 1;
      else high = mid - 1;
    }
    let weight = officeRandom(column, 2, seed) * officeTileWeights.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
    for (let index = 0; index < officeTileWeights.length; index++) {
      weight -= officeTileWeights[index];
      if (weight < 0) return index;
    }
    return 0;
  };
}

export const officeTileIndex = createOfficeTileSelector();

/** Match Stage 1's enlarged height while overlapping horizontal seams by 2px. */
export function officeMetrics(viewportHeight) {
  const scale = viewportHeight * mapSizeMultiplier / 1086;
  const width = 1448 * scale;
  return { scale, width, height: 1086 * scale, stride: width - overlap };
}

/** Query only obstacle boxes near a world region; tiles own no enemy records. */
export function officeObstaclesIn(map, viewportHeight, left, top, right, bottom) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(viewportHeight);
  const boxes = [];
  const first = Math.floor((left - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((right - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    for (const [x1, y1, x2, y2] of officeObstacleBoxes[officeTileIndex(column)]) {
      const box = { left: map.originX + column * metrics.stride + x1 * metrics.scale,
        right: map.originX + column * metrics.stride + x2 * metrics.scale,
        top: map.originY + y1 * metrics.scale, bottom: map.originY + y2 * metrics.scale };
      if (box.bottom >= top && box.top <= bottom) boxes.push(box);
    }
  }
  return boxes;
}

/** Validate spawns against the office obstacle artwork. */
export function canStandInOffice(character, x, y, map, height) {
  return canStand(character, x, y, (...region) => officeObstaclesIn(map, height, ...region));
}

/** Reuse Stage 3 substepped collision and wall sliding for the office. */
export function resolveOfficeMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, height) {
  return resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY,
    (...region) => officeObstaclesIn(map, height, ...region));
}

/** Render only visible columns; horizontal position alone determines their layout. */
export function drawOfficeWorld(context, map, camera, width, height) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(height);
  const first = Math.floor((camera.x - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((camera.x + width - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    const x = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride - camera.x);
    const right = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride + metrics.width - camera.x);
    const y = Math.round(map.originY - camera.y);
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[officeTileIndex(column)].image, x, y, right - x, Math.round(metrics.height));
  }
}

/** Return a source rectangle using the sheet's uneven per-column row boundaries. */
function getFrameRectangle(character, frame) {
  const facing = character.horizontalFacingOnly ? character.facing : character.direction;
  const row = character.attack
    ? character.attacks[character.attack.name].rows[character.attack.facing]
    : !character.moving && character.idleRows?.[facing] !== undefined
    ? character.idleRows[facing]
    : character.rows[facing];
  // Attack artwork can exceed the grid cell. Custom rectangles keep the tank's
  // anchor fixed even when a muzzle flash needs a wider crop.
  const custom = character.layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
  if (custom) return custom;
  const { columnEdges, rowEdges } = character.layout;
  return {
    x: columnEdges[frame],
    y: rowEdges[frame][row],
    width: columnEdges[frame + 1] - columnEdges[frame],
    height: rowEdges[frame][row + 1] - rowEdges[frame][row],
    footY: character.layout.footY?.[frame]?.[row] ?? rowEdges[frame][row + 1]

export const officeTileIndex = createOfficeTileSelector();

/** Match Stage 1's enlarged height while overlapping horizontal seams by 2px. */
export function officeMetrics(viewportHeight) {
  const scale = viewportHeight * mapSizeMultiplier / 1086;
  const width = 1448 * scale;
  return { scale, width, height: 1086 * scale, stride: width - overlap };
}

/** Query only obstacle boxes near a world region; tiles own no enemy records. */
export function officeObstaclesIn(map, viewportHeight, left, top, right, bottom) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(viewportHeight);
  const boxes = [];
  const first = Math.floor((left - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((right - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    for (const [x1, y1, x2, y2] of officeObstacleBoxes[officeTileIndex(column)]) {
      const box = { left: map.originX + column * metrics.stride + x1 * metrics.scale,
        right: map.originX + column * metrics.stride + x2 * metrics.scale,
        top: map.originY + y1 * metrics.scale, bottom: map.originY + y2 * metrics.scale };
      if (box.bottom >= top && box.top <= bottom) boxes.push(box);
    }
  }
  return boxes;
}

/** Validate spawns against the office obstacle artwork. */
export function canStandInOffice(character, x, y, map, height) {
  return canStand(character, x, y, (...region) => officeObstaclesIn(map, height, ...region));
}

/** Reuse Stage 3 substepped collision and wall sliding for the office. */
export function resolveOfficeMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, height) {
  return resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY,
    (...region) => officeObstaclesIn(map, height, ...region));
}

/** Render only visible columns; horizontal position alone determines their layout. */
export function drawOfficeWorld(context, map, camera, width, height) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(height);
  const first = Math.floor((camera.x - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((camera.x + width - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    const x = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride - camera.x);
    const right = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride + metrics.width - camera.x);
    const y = Math.round(map.originY - camera.y);
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[officeTileIndex(column)].image, x, y, right - x, Math.round(metrics.height));
  }
}

/** Coordinate hash shared in spirit and seed with the other procedural stages. */
function palaceRandom(row, salt, seed) {
  let hash = Math.imul(row | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(salt, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 16), 0x7feb352d);
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 15), 0x846ca68b);
  return ((hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}

/** Choose within a weighted pool without altering the pool's overall chance. */
function weightedIndex(value, weights) {
  let remaining = value * weights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
    remaining -= weights[i];
    if (remaining < 0) return i;
  }
  return weights.length - 1;
}

/** Resolve the exact 5% rare pool followed by its conditional 10/5/5/10/35/35 split. */
export function palaceTileFromRolls(poolRoll, variantRoll) {
  return poolRoll < palaceRareChance ? 9 + weightedIndex(variantRoll, palaceRareWeights)
    : weightedIndex(variantRoll, palaceCommonWeights);
}

/** Stable vertical tile choice, including negative rows, independent of visit order. */
export function palaceTileIndex(row, seed = worldSeed) {
  return palaceTileFromRolls(palaceRandom(row, 11, seed), palaceRandom(row, 12, seed));
}

/** Keep the enlarged width and a 2px seam overlap while scrolling vertically. */
export function palaceMetrics(viewportWidth) {
  const scale = viewportWidth * mapSizeMultiplier / 941;
  const height = 1672 * scale;
  return { scale, width: 941 * scale, height, stride: height - 2 };
}

/** Return obstacle rectangles only for nearby vertical tiles. */
export function palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, left, top, right, bottom) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width), boxes = [];
  const first = Math.floor((top - map.originY - 2) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((bottom - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    for (const [x1, y1, x2, y2] of palaceObstacleBoxes[palaceTileIndex(row)]) {
      const box = { left: map.originX + x1 * metrics.scale, right: map.originX + x2 * metrics.scale,
        top: map.originY + row * metrics.stride + y1 * metrics.scale,
        bottom: map.originY + row * metrics.stride + y2 * metrics.scale };
      if (box.right >= left && box.left <= right) boxes.push(box);
    }
  }
  return boxes;
}

/** Reject NPC spawns inside the same obstacle boxes used by movement. */
export function canStandInPalace(character, x, y, map, width) {
  return canStand(character, x, y, (...region) => palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, ...region));
}

/** Reuse substepped collision and axis sliding from Stage 3. */
export function resolvePalaceMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, width) {
  return resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY,
    (...region) => palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, ...region));
}

/** Render only rows that intersect the camera, without allocating tile objects. */
export function drawPalaceWorld(context, map, camera, width, height) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width);
  const first = Math.floor((camera.y - map.originY - 2) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((camera.y + height - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    const x = Math.round(map.originX - camera.x);
    const y = Math.round(map.originY + row * metrics.stride - camera.y);
    const bottom = Math.round(map.originY + row * metrics.stride + metrics.height - camera.y);
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[palaceTileIndex(row)].image, x, y, Math.round(metrics.width), bottom - y);
  }
}

/** Redraw only a statue silhouette over an actor standing behind its pedestal. */
export function drawPalaceOcclusion(context, character, map, camera, width) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width), size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const footY = character.y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
  const first = Math.floor((character.y - size - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((character.y + size - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    const index = palaceTileIndex(row), statue = palaceStatues[index];
    const originY = map.originY + row * metrics.stride;
    if (!statue || footY >= originY + statue.baseBottom * metrics.scale) continue;
    context.save();
    context.beginPath();
    context.rect(character.x - camera.x - size / 2, character.y - camera.y - size / 2, size, size);
    context.clip();
    context.beginPath();
    statue.polygon.forEach(([x,y], i) => {
      const px = map.originX + x * metrics.scale - camera.x;
      const py = originY + y * metrics.scale - camera.y;
      if (i === 0) context.moveTo(px, py); else context.lineTo(px, py);
    });
    context.closePath();
    context.clip();
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[index].image, map.originX - camera.x, originY - camera.y, metrics.width, metrics.height);
    context.restore();
  }
}

/** Stable vertical tile choice, including negative rows, independent of visit order. */
export function palaceTileIndex(row, seed = worldSeed) {
  return palaceTileFromRolls(palaceRandom(row, 11, seed), palaceRandom(row, 12, seed));
}

/** Keep the enlarged width and a 2px seam overlap while scrolling vertically. */
export function palaceMetrics(viewportWidth) {
  const scale = viewportWidth * mapSizeMultiplier / 941;
  const height = 1672 * scale;
  return { scale, width: 941 * scale, height, stride: height - 2 };
}

/** Return obstacle rectangles only for nearby vertical tiles. */
export function palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, left, top, right, bottom) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width), boxes = [];
  const first = Math.floor((top - map.originY - 2) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((bottom - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    for (const [x1, y1, x2, y2] of palaceObstacleBoxes[palaceTileIndex(row)]) {
      const box = { left: map.originX + x1 * metrics.scale, right: map.originX + x2 * metrics.scale,
        top: map.originY + row * metrics.stride + y1 * metrics.scale,
        bottom: map.originY + row * metrics.stride + y2 * metrics.scale };
      if (box.right >= left && box.left <= right) boxes.push(box);
    }
  }
  return boxes;
}

/** Reject NPC spawns inside the same obstacle boxes used by movement. */
export function canStandInPalace(character, x, y, map, width) {
  return canStand(character, x, y, (...region) => palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, ...region));
}

/** Reuse substepped collision and axis sliding from Stage 3. */
export function resolvePalaceMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, width) {
    const distance = Math.abs(column);
    const monuments = sign < 0 ? streams.left : streams.right;
    while (monuments[monuments.length - 1] < distance) {
      const previous = monuments[monuments.length - 1];
      let step = 1;
      for (; step < officeMonument.pityDistance; step++) {
        if (officeRandom(sign * (previous + step), 1, seed) < officeMonument.chance) break;
      }
      monuments.push(previous + step);
    }
    let low = 1, high = monuments.length - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
      if (monuments[mid] === distance) return officeMonument.index;
      if (monuments[mid] < distance) low = mid + 1;
      else high = mid - 1;
    }
    let weight = officeRandom(column, 2, seed) * officeTileWeights.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
    for (let index = 0; index < officeTileWeights.length; index++) {
      weight -= officeTileWeights[index];
      if (weight < 0) return index;
    }
    return 0;
  };
}

export const officeTileIndex = createOfficeTileSelector();

function officeRandom(column, salt, seed) {

}

    context.rect(character.x - camera.x - size / 2, character.y - camera.y - size / 2, size, size);
    context.clip();
    context.beginPath();
    statue.polygon.forEach(([x,y], i) => {
      const px = map.originX + x * metrics.scale - camera.x;
      const py = originY + y * metrics.scale - camera.y;
      if (i === 0) context.moveTo(px, py); else context.lineTo(px, py);
    });
    context.closePath();
    context.clip();
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[index].image, map.originX - camera.x, originY - camera.y, metrics.width, metrics.height);
    context.restore();
  }

/** Reset character positions and horizontal camera without changing sprite settings. */
function resetScene() {
  umbrellaAttack?.reset();
  aiming?.reset();
  releaseControls();
  for (const character of Object.values(characters)) {
    character.x = canvas.width * 0.4;
    character.y = canvas.height * 0.6;
    if (currentMap === 'first') character.y += maps.first.originY;
    if (currentMap === 'second') character.x += maps.second.originX;
    if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
      character.x = maps.fourth.originX + 740 * islandScale;
      character.y = maps.fourth.originY + 620 * islandScale - (character.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2 + spritePadding;
    }
    character.direction = character.defaultDirection || 'down';
    if (character.horizontalFacingOnly) character.facing = character.direction;
    character.elapsed = 0;
    character.moving = false;
    character.attack = null;
    character.transition = null;
  }
  camera.x = 0;
  camera.y = 0;
  cameraAnchor.x = canvas.width / 2;
  cameraAnchor.y = canvas.height / 2;
  updateCamera();
  updateAttackControls();
}

/** Follow the active character through positive and negative world coordinates. */
function updateCamera(delta = 0) {
  // Ease the retained screen anchor toward center after changing map axes.
  // World coordinates never change; the entire scene follows the same camera.
  const blend = 1 - Math.exp(-cameraRecenterSpeed * delta);
  cameraAnchor.x += (canvas.width / 2 - cameraAnchor.x) * blend;
  cameraAnchor.y += (canvas.height / 2 - cameraAnchor.y) * blend;

/** Mix local start time with random entropy so each new run gets a fresh seed. */
export function createRunSeed(time = new Date(), entropy) {
  if (entropy === undefined) {
    entropy = globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues
      ? globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0]
      : Math.floor(Math.random() * 4294967296);
  }
  const localTime = [time.getFullYear(), time.getMonth(), time.getDate(),
    time.getHours(), time.getMinutes(), time.getSeconds(), time.getMilliseconds(),
    time.getTimezoneOffset(), entropy].join(':');
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (const character of localTime) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ character.charCodeAt(0), 16777619);
  return (hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0;
}

// Generated once per page/game start; map changes and scene resets reuse it.
export const runStartedAt = new Date();
export const runSeed = createRunSeed(runStartedAt);

import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { mapSizeMultiplier } from './map-bounds.js';
import { runSeed } from './run-seed.js';
// All procedural maps share this run's seed; coordinate generation stays stable.
export const worldSeed = runSeed;
export const tileWeights = [35, 23, 16, 11, 10, 5];
export const tileWidth = 960 * mapSizeMultiplier;
export const tileHeight = 720 * mapSizeMultiplier;
export const tileOverlap = 2; // EDIT shared edge overlap in world pixels to hide seams.
const tileStrideX = tileWidth - tileOverlap;
const tileStrideY = tileHeight - tileOverlap;
const sourceScale = tileWidth / 1448;

// EDIT obstacle rectangles in SOURCE IMAGE pixels: [left, top, right, bottom].
// These deliberately cover the obstacle artwork, excluding its cast shadow.
export const obstacleBoxes = [
  [[1030, 25, 1425, 330], [165, 725, 370, 910]],
  [[1020, 95, 1300, 345], [870, 480, 1040, 665], [170, 755, 400, 950]],
  [[1040, 110, 1290, 350], [175, 735, 325, 915]],
  [[930, 175, 1160, 370], [230, 410, 455, 600], [875, 695, 1060, 850]],
  [[1020, 95, 1300, 345], [165, 300, 365, 470], [795, 475, 1060, 685], [170, 755, 400, 950]],
  [[735, 95, 1055, 300], [185, 270, 400, 455], [1040, 515, 1315, 770], [260, 715, 495, 895]]
];

/** Produce a stable weighted tile index for positive or negative grid coordinates. */
export function tileIndex(column, row, seed = worldSeed) {
  let hash = Math.imul(column | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(row | 0, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 16), 0x7feb352d);
  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 15), 0x846ca68b);
  hash = (hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0;
  let value = hash / 4294967296 * tileWeights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < tileWeights.length; i++) {
    value -= tileWeights[i];
    if (value < 0) return i;
  }
  return tileWeights.length - 1;
}

/** Query obstacle rectangles only for tiles touched by a local world region. */
export function obstaclesIn(left, top, right, bottom) {
  const rectangles = [];
  for (let row = Math.floor((top - tileOverlap) / tileStrideY); row <= Math.floor(bottom / tileStrideY); row++) {
    for (let column = Math.floor((left - tileOverlap) / tileStrideX); column <= Math.floor(right / tileStrideX); column++) {
      for (const box of obstacleBoxes[tileIndex(column, row)]) {
        rectangles.push({
          left: column * tileStrideX + box[0] * sourceScale,
          top: row * tileStrideY + box[1] * sourceScale,
          right: column * tileStrideX + box[2] * sourceScale,
          bottom: row * tileStrideY + box[3] * sourceScale
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return rectangles;
}

/** Draw only visible seeded tiles; generation allocates no persistent tile cache. */
export function drawTileWorld(context, images, camera, width, height, debug = false) {
  for (let row = Math.floor((camera.y - tileOverlap) / tileStrideY); row <= Math.floor((camera.y + height) / tileStrideY); row++) {
    for (let column = Math.floor((camera.x - tileOverlap) / tileStrideX); column <= Math.floor((camera.x + width) / tileStrideX); column++) {
      const x = Math.round(column * tileStrideX - camera.x);
      const y = Math.round(row * tileStrideY - camera.y);
      const right = Math.round(column * tileStrideX + tileWidth - camera.x);
      const bottom = Math.round(row * tileStrideY + tileHeight - camera.y);
      context.drawImage(images[tileIndex(column, row)].image, x, y, right - x, bottom - y);
    }
  }
  if (debug) {
    context.save();
    context.strokeStyle = '#ffcf60';
    context.lineWidth = 2;
    for (const box of obstaclesIn(camera.x, camera.y, camera.x + width, camera.y + height)) {
      context.strokeRect(box.left - camera.x, box.top - camera.y, box.right - box.left, box.bottom - box.top);
    }
    context.restore();
  }
}

/** Coordinate hash shared in spirit and seed with the other procedural stages. */
function palaceRandom(row, salt, seed) {
  let hash = Math.imul(row | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(salt, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;

  return ((hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
